words.enDefinition: return to its original or usable and functioning condition

examples.en: The power company restored electricity to our street before midnight.
examples.zh: 电力公司在午夜前「恢复」了我们街道的供电。

examples.en: Grandpa carefully restored the old rocking chair to its former shine.
examples.zh: 爷爷细心「修复」了旧摇椅，让它重现往日的光亮。

words.enDefinition: being directly across from each other; facing

examples.en: The pharmacy sits on the opposite side of the road from the bakery.
examples.zh: 药房在面包店马路「对面」。

examples.en: We walked in opposite directions around the lake and met halfway.
examples.zh: 我们沿湖朝「相反」方向走，在半路相遇。

words.enDefinition: be worthy or deserving

examples.en: The volunteers deserve a hot meal after cleaning the whole beach.
examples.zh: 清理了整片海滩之后，志愿者们「理应」吃顿热饭。

examples.en: Grandma's dumplings deserve their wide fame in three neighboring towns.
examples.zh: 奶奶的饺子「配得上」它在邻镇的广泛名气。

words.enDefinition: small house with a single story

examples.en: We rented a stone cottage near the lake for the whole summer.
examples.zh: 整个夏天，我们在湖边租了一栋石砌「小屋」。

examples.en: Grandma's cottage smells of woodsmoke and fresh bread every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，奶奶的「小屋」里都是柴火香和新面包味。

words.enDefinition: the act of discovering something

examples.en: Grandpa's discovery of the old well saved our garden project.
examples.zh: 爷爷对旧水井的「发现」救了我们的花园计划。

examples.en: The detective's discovery of a torn ticket cracked the case.
examples.zh: 侦探「发现」一张撕破的票根，破解了案子。

words.enDefinition: natural body of running water flowing on or under the earth

examples.en: Children race paper boats down the stream after heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，孩子们在「小溪」里赛纸船。

examples.en: Grandpa rests his fishing stool beside the stream every Sunday.
examples.zh: 每周日，爷爷都把钓鱼凳放在「溪流」边休息。

words.enDefinition: notoriety for some particular characteristic

examples.en: The baker's reputation for honest weights spread across three towns.
examples.zh: 这位面包师「分量足」的名声传遍了三个镇。

examples.en: Grandma protects the family's good reputation by keeping every promise.
examples.zh: 奶奶信守每一个承诺，守护着全家的「名誉」。

words.enDefinition: a deliberate discourtesy or insult; an act of neglecting someone

examples.en: Not inviting grandma to the reunion was a deliberate slight.
examples.zh: 家庭聚会没请奶奶，是故意「怠慢」她。

examples.en: He felt the slight deeply when the coach skipped his name.
examples.zh: 教练跳过他的名字时，他深深感到了「轻慢」。

words.enDefinition: an expression of greeting

examples.en: Grandma picks up the phone with a warm hello every time.
examples.zh: 奶奶每次接电话都热情地「打招呼」。

examples.en: The twins ran to the fence shouting hello to the postman.
examples.zh: 双胞胎跑到篱笆边，大声向邮差「问好」。

words.enDefinition: an established custom

examples.en: Grandpa has a habit of reading the paper before sunrise.
examples.zh: 爷爷有日出前读报的「习惯」。

examples.en: Biting my pen while thinking is a habit I can't shake.
examples.zh: 思考时咬笔是我改不掉的「习惯」。

words.enDefinition: edge tool used as a cutting instrument; has a pointed blade with a sharp edge and a handle

examples.en: Grandpa sharpens every kitchen knife on the whetstone after Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 周日晚餐后，爷爷都在磨石上打磨每一把厨房「刀」。

examples.en: Keep the camping knife in its sheath until the counselor checks it.
examples.zh: 在辅导员检查之前，把露营「小刀」收在刀鞘里。

words.enDefinition: kind and pleasant to others; showing kindness

examples.en: The shopkeeper's friendly greeting makes every morning at the bakery nicer.
examples.zh: 店主「友好的」问候让面包店的每个早晨都更舒心。

examples.en: Our new neighbours are friendly enough to share their garden plums.
examples.zh: 我们的新邻居很「友善」，连园子里的李子都分给我们。

words.enDefinition: in a foreign country

examples.en: My cousin studies abroad in Melbourne and calls every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我表姐「在国外」上学，每周日都从墨尔本来电话。

examples.en: Grandpa worked abroad on cargo ships for almost ten years.
examples.zh: 爷爷「在国外」跑货船跑了将近十年。

words.enDefinition: soft white precious univalent metallic element having the highest electrical and thermal conductivity of any metal; occurs in argentite and in free form; used in coins and jewelry and tableware and photography

examples.en: Grandma polishes the silver spoons before every family reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 每次家庭团聚聚餐之前，奶奶都会擦拭「银」汤匙。

examples.en: The river stones glittered like silver in the morning sun.
examples.zh: 晨光下，河里的卵石闪着「银色」的光。

words.enDefinition: person who has been converted to another religious or political belief

examples.en: As a recent convert, Mia attends every discussion class eagerly.
examples.zh: 作为新「皈依者」，米娅热切地参加每一堂研讨课。

examples.en: The priest welcomed the convert and his family after the service.
examples.zh: 仪式结束后，神父欢迎了那位「皈依者」和他的家人。

words.enDefinition: rural regions

examples.en: The whole family escapes to the countryside every Golden Week.
examples.zh: 黄金周里，全家人都会逃往「乡下」。

examples.en: Grandpa says the quiet countryside cured his city headaches at last.
examples.zh: 爷爷说，安静的「乡村」终于治好了他在城里犯的头疼。

words.enDefinition: happening without warning or in a short space of time

examples.en: A sudden rain chased the whole market under the awnings.
examples.zh: 一场「突然」的大雨把整个集市的人都赶进了雨棚。

examples.en: The gardener stopped mid-row when a sudden gust scattered seeds.
examples.zh: 一阵「突然」的风刮散了种子，园丁停下了手里的活。

words.enDefinition: the domain ruled by an emperor or empress; the region over which imperial dominion is exercised

examples.en: The museum's map shows the empire's trade roads two thousand years ago.
examples.zh: 博物馆的地图展示了两千年前「帝国」的商路。

examples.en: Legends say the old empire built this wall in a single winter.
examples.zh: 传说古「帝国」一个冬天就筑起了这堵墙。

words.enDefinition: the season when the leaves fall from the trees

examples.en: Autumn paints the hillside vineyards gold before the harvest festival.
examples.zh: 丰收节之前，「秋天」把山坡上的葡萄园染成金色。

examples.en: Grandma rakes maple leaves every autumn and burns them at dusk.
examples.zh: 每年「秋天」，奶奶都耙拢枫叶，傍晚烧掉。

words.enDefinition: the rational investigation of questions about existence and knowledge and ethics

examples.en: Grandpa's life philosophy is simple: fix it today, not tomorrow.
examples.zh: 爷爷的「人生哲学」很简单：今天修，不拖到明天。

examples.en: The bookstore's philosophy shelf holds two worn volumes of Plato.
examples.zh: 书店的「哲学」书架上放着两本翻旧了的柏拉图。

words.enDefinition: an edible tuber native to South America; a staple food of Ireland

examples.en: Grandma grows a potato variety that keeps all winter in the cellar.
examples.zh: 奶奶种的「马铃薯」品种能在地窖里存放一整个冬天。

examples.en: The campfire potatoes slowly turned golden inside their foil jackets.
examples.zh: 篝火上的「土豆」在锡纸里慢慢烤得金黄。

words.enDefinition: person related by blood or marriage

examples.en: Every relative brought a dish to grandpa's eightieth birthday lunch.
examples.zh: 爷爷八十大寿的午餐上，每位「亲戚」都带了一道菜。

examples.en: A distant relative from Canada visited the farm last autumn.
examples.zh: 去年秋天，一位加拿大的远房「亲戚」来农场做客。

words.enDefinition: draw air into, and expel out of, the lungs

examples.en: Breathe slowly and deeply while the doctor listens to your chest.
examples.zh: 医生听诊的时候，请缓慢而深深地「呼吸」。

examples.en: Grandpa breathes deeply by the sea every morning after retirement.
examples.zh: 退休之后，爷爷每天清晨都在海边深深「呼吸」。

words.enDefinition: in the near future; before long

examples.en: The bakery reopens shortly after the health inspection finishes today.
examples.zh: 今天卫生检查结束后，面包店「很快」就会重新开门。

examples.en: Grandma will call you back shortly; she is still at the market.
examples.zh: 奶奶「稍后」会回电话，她还在市场呢。

words.enDefinition: flavorful relish or dressing or topping served as an accompaniment to food

examples.en: Grandma simmers the tomato sauce for three hours on Sundays.
examples.zh: 每周日，奶奶都用三个小时慢炖番茄「酱」。

examples.en: The chef drizzled a sweet plum sauce over the roasted duck.
examples.zh: 厨师在烤鸭上淋了甜梅「酱」。

words.enDefinition: at the beginning

examples.en: Initially, the bakery sold only plain bread before adding sweet cakes.
examples.zh: 「最初」，这家面包店只卖白面包，后来才添加了甜蛋糕。

examples.en: Grandma was initially unsure about the smartphone but now sends photos.
examples.zh: 奶奶「起初」不太敢用智能手机，现在都会发照片了。

words.enDefinition: clergyman in Christian churches who has the authority to perform or administer various religious rites; one of the Holy Orders

examples.en: The village priest blesses the fishing fleet every single spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，村里的「神父」都会为渔船队祈福。

examples.en: Our parish priest visits the elderly members every Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们教区的「神父」每周四下午探望年长的教友。

words.enDefinition: surprising greatly

examples.en: The twins' sandcastle looked amazing after two whole hours of work.
examples.zh: 花了整整两个小时，双胞胎的沙堡「惊艳」极了。

examples.en: Grandpa told amazing stories about his voyages around the cape.
examples.zh: 爷爷讲的环航故事「令人惊叹」。

words.enDefinition: alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard

examples.en: Please adjust the car mirror before we drive down the coast.
examples.zh: 沿海岸开车之前，请先「调整」后视镜。

examples.en: Grandpa adjusted the chair's height until grandma's back felt easy.
examples.zh: 爷爷反复「调整」椅子高度，直到奶奶坐得舒坦。

words.enDefinition: go into retirement; stop performing one's work or withdraw from one's position

examples.en: Grandpa retired from the ferry company after thirty-one long years.
examples.zh: 爷爷在渡轮公司干了漫长的三十一年之后「退休」了。

examples.en: The famous painter retired to a seaside village to paint gulls.
examples.zh: 那位著名画家「退休」后隐居在海边村庄画海鸥。

words.enDefinition: the brother of your father or mother; the husband of your aunt

examples.en: Uncle Ray brings oysters to every family gathering at the farm.
examples.zh: 雷「叔叔」每次来农场聚会都带牡蛎。

examples.en: My uncle in Guangzhou taught me to fold paper boats.
examples.zh: 广州的「舅舅」教我折纸船。

words.enDefinition: lasting only for a limited time; not permanent

examples.en: The bakery hired temporary staff for the busy moon-festival week.
examples.zh: 月饼旺季的那一周，面包店雇了「临时」员工。

examples.en: We live in temporary housing until the farmhouse repairs finish.
examples.zh: 农舍修好之前，我们先住在「临时」住房里。

words.enDefinition: capable of being seen; or open to easy view

examples.en: The lighthouse stays visible from our porch on clear nights.
examples.zh: 晴朗的夜晚，从我们的门廊就能「看见」灯塔。

examples.en: Grandpa's footprints were visible across the frosty garden at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，霜冻的园子里爷爷的脚印「清晰可见」。

words.enDefinition: an episode that is turbulent or highly emotional

examples.en: Our school drama club performs a folk play every spring.
examples.zh: 我们学校的「戏剧」社每年春天演一出民间剧。

examples.en: Grandma loves radio dramas about old village life after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后，奶奶爱听讲述旧时乡村生活的广播「剧」。

words.enDefinition: the liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue by squeezing or cooking

examples.en: Fresh orange juice goes with every breakfast at the guesthouse.
examples.zh: 旅馆的每顿早餐都配有鲜榨橙「汁」。

examples.en: Grandpa squeezed lemon juice over the grilled fish at the pier.
examples.zh: 在码头上，爷爷往烤鱼上挤了柠檬「汁」。

words.enDefinition: conj. At whatever time.

examples.en: Whenever the bell rings, the twins race to the door.
examples.zh: 「每当」铃响，双胞胎就冲向门口。

examples.en: Drop by the bakery whenever you pass the old bridge.
examples.zh: 「无论何时」路过老桥，都可以顺路来面包店坐坐。

words.enDefinition: an act that has disastrous consequences

examples.en: The kitchen fire was a small disaster, but nobody was hurt.
examples.zh: 厨房火灾是场小「灾难」，所幸没有人受伤。

examples.en: Skipping the ferry reservation proved a disaster in peak season.
examples.zh: 旺季不订船票真是个「灾难性」的失误。

words.enDefinition: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained

examples.en: The missing garden gnome became a mystery for the whole street.
examples.zh: 花园小矮人雕像失踪成了整条街的「谜」。

examples.en: Nobody could explain the mystery of the ringing wind chimes.
examples.zh: 谁也解释不了风铃自鸣的「神秘现象」。

words.enDefinition: an arbitrary sign (written or printed) that has acquired a conventional significance

examples.en: The red cross is the symbol of our village clinic on the map.
examples.zh: 地图上，红十字是我们村诊所的「标志」。

examples.en: Grandma explained that the fish symbol means luck in her hometown.
examples.zh: 奶奶解释说，鱼形「符号」在她的家乡代表好运。

words.enDefinition: the space between two lines or planes that intersect; the inclination of one line to another; measured in degrees or radians

examples.en: The carpenter measured a perfect right angle for the door frame.
examples.zh: 木匠为门框量出了一个精确的直「角」。

examples.en: Viewed from this angle, the old bridge looks like a rainbow.
examples.zh: 从这个「角度」看，老桥像一道彩虹。

words.enDefinition: screen for display; a person who watches or checks something

examples.en: The baby monitor lets grandma hear the nursery from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 有了婴儿「监视器」，奶奶在厨房也能听到育儿室的动静。

examples.en: Our homeroom teacher serves as the lunch monitor every Friday.
examples.zh: 每逢周五，班主任都担任午餐「监督员」。

words.enDefinition: an activity that is diverting and that holds the attention

examples.en: The festival's live entertainment includes lion dancers and puppet shows.
examples.zh: 节日的现场「娱乐」节目包括舞狮和木偶戏。

examples.en: Grandma finds her favorite evening entertainment in radio quiz programs.
examples.zh: 奶奶最爱的晚间「消遣」是广播问答节目。

words.enDefinition: strong emotion; a feeling that is oriented toward some real or supposed grievance

examples.en: Dad hid his anger when the neighbor's dog dug the flowerbeds.
examples.zh: 邻居的狗刨了花坛，爸爸压住了自己的「怒火」。

examples.en: Grandma's quiet anger spoke louder than any loud shouting match.
examples.zh: 奶奶无声的「愤怒」比任何争吵都更有分量。

words.enDefinition: not in accordance with the fact or reality or actuality

examples.en: The false alarm sent firefighters racing to the empty warehouse.
examples.zh: 一场「虚假」警报让消防车白跑了一趟空仓库。

examples.en: Grandpa's beard looks false until you notice the grey roots.
examples.zh: 爷爷的胡子看着像「假的」，直到你注意到那灰白的发根。

words.enDefinition: natural or artificial enclosed space

examples.en: The castle's hidden chamber once stored grain during long sieges.
examples.zh: 长期被围困时，城堡的密「室」曾用来储存粮食。

examples.en: Each chamber of the beehive holds perfectly six-sided honey cells.
examples.zh: 蜂巢的每个「巢室」都有完美的六边形蜜房。

words.enDefinition: the state of being honored

examples.en: It's an honour to carry the flag at the graduation.
examples.zh: 在毕业典礼上扛旗是一种「荣誉」。

examples.en: Grandma earned the village's honour for fifty years of teaching.
examples.zh: 奶奶执教五十年，为村子赢得了「荣誉」。

words.enDefinition: worthy of acceptance or satisfactory

examples.en: Handwriting one page daily is acceptable practice for the exam.
examples.zh: 每天手写一页是考试前「可以接受的」练习量。

examples.en: Grandma says slightly burnt toast is acceptable with enough jam.
examples.zh: 奶奶说烤得稍焦的面包片，多抹点果酱也「能接受」。

words.enDefinition: the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form

examples.en: The sweet smell of cinnamon filled grandma's kitchen at noon.
examples.zh: 正午时分，奶奶的厨房里满是肉桂的甜「香」。

examples.en: The harbor's salty smell drifts in through our open windows.
examples.zh: 海港的咸「味」从敞开的窗户飘了进来。

words.enDefinition: someone who travels for pleasure

examples.en: A lost tourist asked us for the way to the lighthouse.
examples.zh: 一位迷路的「游客」向我们打听去灯塔的路。

examples.en: The night market fills with happy tourists every summer weekend.
examples.zh: 夏天每逢周末，夜市里都挤满开心的「游客」。

words.enDefinition: having the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task

examples.en: One big pot of rice is adequate for the whole team.
examples.zh: 一大锅米饭「足够」全队的人吃。

examples.en: The old pump gives adequate water for two garden rows.
examples.zh: 旧水泵供的水「够」浇两畦菜。

words.enDefinition: an edible emulsion of fat globules made by churning milk or cream; for cooking and table use

examples.en: Grandma spreads honey and soft butter on the Sunday toast.
examples.zh: 周日的吐司上，奶奶抹上蜂蜜和软「黄油」。

examples.en: Melt the butter slowly before you stir in the flour.
examples.zh: 先把「黄油」慢慢融化，然后拌入面粉。

words.enDefinition: room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet

examples.en: The guest bathroom's towels have little embroidered sailboats on them.
examples.zh: 客用「浴室」的毛巾上绣着小小的帆船。

examples.en: Grandpa fixed the dripping bathroom tap before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到达之前，爷爷修好了「浴室」滴水的龙头。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to electronics; concerned with or using devices that operate on principles governing the behavior of electrons

examples.en: The library uses electronic keys instead of metal ones now.
examples.zh: 图书馆现在用「电子」钥匙代替了金属钥匙。

examples.en: Grandma still prefers paper books to electronic readers at bedtime.
examples.zh: 睡前，奶奶仍偏爱纸质书，而不是「电子」阅读器。

words.enDefinition: oppose, as in hostility or a competition

examples.en: Mia finally confronted her fear of deep water at the pool.
examples.zh: 在泳池里，米娅终于「直面」了对深水的恐惧。

examples.en: Grandpa politely confronted the neighbors about their very late-night karaoke.
examples.zh: 爷爷礼貌地跟邻居「交涉」了他们深夜唱卡拉OK的事。

words.enDefinition: stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something

examples.en: The twins couldn't resist the fresh strawberry tarts in the window.
examples.zh: 双胞胎「抵挡不住」橱窗里新鲜出炉的草莓塔。

examples.en: The old seawall resisted the storm surge better than expected.
examples.zh: 老海堤「顶住」了风暴潮，比预想的更牢固。

words.enDefinition: total and complete; not limited or relative

examples.en: Grandma trusts the recipe with absolute certainty after forty years.
examples.zh: 四十年之后，奶奶对这份食谱有着「绝对」的把握。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps absolute silence in the workshop before he planes wood.
examples.zh: 刨木头之前，爷爷的工作间里「绝对」安静。

words.enDefinition: an unvarying or habitual method or procedure

examples.en: Grandma's morning routine starts with feeding the cats at six.
examples.zh: 奶奶的晨间「例行安排」从六点喂猫开始。

examples.en: After the harvest, the farm slips into a quieter routine.
examples.zh: 丰收过后，农场转入更清闲的「日常」。

words.enDefinition: having an even surface; happening without difficulties or problems

examples.en: Grandma smooths the quilt until every last wrinkle is gone.
examples.zh: 奶奶把被子抚「平」，直到最后一道褶皱都消失。

examples.en: The move to the new flat was smooth, thanks to friends.
examples.zh: 多亏朋友们帮忙，搬进新公寓「一路顺利」。

words.enDefinition: the part of a golf course bordering the fairway where the grass is not cut short

examples.en: His first drive landed in the rough beside the fairway.
examples.zh: 他第一杆开球就落进了球道旁的「长草区」。

examples.en: Golfers say the rough punishes careless swings on windy days.
examples.zh: 球友们说，刮风天一杆打歪，就会在「长草区」吃苦头。

words.enDefinition: unusual or striking

examples.en: Grandma's memory for old village recipes is truly quite remarkable.
examples.zh: 奶奶对乡村老食谱的记忆力确实「非凡」。

examples.en: The lighthouse keeper's remarkable logbooks span sixty stormy winter seasons.
examples.zh: 灯塔看守人「了不起的」航海日志记录了六十个风雪之冬。

words.enDefinition: the largest possible quantity

examples.en: The ferry carries a maximum of ninety passengers per crossing.
examples.zh: 渡轮每航次最多载客九十人，这是「上限」。

examples.en: Grandpa says the mill runs at maximum speed before the fair.
examples.zh: 爷爷说赶集之前，磨坊会以「最大」转速运转。

words.enDefinition: furnishings that make a room or other area ready for occupancy

examples.en: Grandma's oak furniture has survived three generations of family dinners.
examples.zh: 奶奶的橡木「家具」已经见证了三代人的家庭聚餐。

examples.en: We moved the heavy furniture before laying the new carpet.
examples.zh: 铺新地毯之前，我们挪开了沉重的「家具」。

words.enDefinition: an official list; to record in an official list

examples.en: The old hotel register shows grandpa stayed here in 1968.
examples.zh: 旅馆的旧「登记簿」显示爷爷 1968 年在这里住过。

examples.en: Please sign the visitor register at the village office first.
examples.zh: 请先在村公所的来访「登记簿」上签名。

words.enDefinition: an anniversary of the day on which a person was born (or the celebration of it)

examples.en: Grandma's birthday party filled the whole courtyard with red lanterns.
examples.zh: 奶奶的「生日」派对挂满红灯笼，占满了整个院子。

examples.en: The twins share one birthday but not one cake, ever.
examples.zh: 双胞胎同一天过「生日」，却从不肯分吃一块蛋糕。

words.enDefinition: speaking softly without vibration of the vocal cords

examples.en: A whisper ran through the audience when the curtain rose.
examples.zh: 大幕升起时，观众席里响起一阵「低语」。

examples.en: Grandpa shared the secret in a whisper behind the barn.
examples.zh: 爷爷在谷仓后面压低声音，用「耳语」说出了那个秘密。

words.enDefinition: the passage to the stomach and lungs; in the front part of the neck below the chin and above the collarbone

examples.en: Honey and warm tea soothed grandpa's sore throat last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚，蜂蜜和热茶缓解了爷爷「嗓子」的疼痛。

examples.en: The choir singer cleared her throat before the solo began.
examples.zh: 独唱开始前，合唱团歌手清了清「嗓子」。

words.enDefinition: term of address for a disrespectful and annoying male

examples.en: As the office junior, Mia fetches the mail every morning.
examples.zh: 作为办公室的「新丁」，米娅每天早上负责取信。

examples.en: The senior students coach the juniors in chess every Wednesday.
examples.zh: 每逢周三，高年级学生都「辅导」低年级生下棋。

words.enDefinition: made or consisting of (entirely or in part) or employing wood

examples.en: Grandpa's old wooden toolbox smells of cedar and linseed oil.
examples.zh: 爷爷的旧「木制」工具箱散发着雪松和亚麻籽油的气味。

examples.en: The pier's wooden boards creak under the fishermen's heavy boots.
examples.zh: 码头的「木头」板在渔夫沉重的靴子下吱呀作响。

words.enDefinition: state of steady vigorous action that is characteristic of an activity

examples.en: The twins take turns on the rope swing by the oak.
examples.zh: 双胞胎轮流玩橡树旁的绳「秋千」。

examples.en: The porch swing creaks gently in the cool evening breeze.
examples.zh: 傍晚的凉风中，门廊「吊椅」轻轻吱呀摇晃。

words.enDefinition: something that remunerates

examples.en: Dad's monthly salary covers the rent and grandma's medicine comfortably.
examples.zh: 爸爸每月的「工资」付完房租，还能宽裕地负担奶奶的药费。

examples.en: The librarian's small salary never dampens her love of books.
examples.zh: 图书管理员的「薪水」微薄，却从未浇灭她对书的热爱。

words.enDefinition: get on top of; deal with successfully

examples.en: Grandpa finally overcame his long fear of dentists at seventy-two.
examples.zh: 七十二岁那年，爷爷终于「克服」了对牙医的多年恐惧。

examples.en: The team overcame a two-goal deficit to win the cup.
examples.zh: 球队「逆转」了两球的劣势，捧起了奖杯。

words.enDefinition: behave in a certain manner

examples.en: The twins behave perfectly whenever their grandma visits the classroom.
examples.zh: 奶奶来教室时，双胞胎「表现」得特别乖。

examples.en: Grandpa taught the puppy to behave at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 爷爷教小狗在餐桌上「守规矩」。

words.enDefinition: approval to do something

examples.en: Dad finally gave permission to paint the fence bright yellow.
examples.zh: 爸爸最终「准许」把篱笆漆成明黄色。

examples.en: You need grandma's permission before you borrow her sewing machine.
examples.zh: 借用奶奶的缝纫机之前，要先征得她的「同意」。

words.enDefinition: the head of a city government

examples.en: The mayor opened the new footbridge beside the old mill.
examples.zh: 「市长」为老磨坊旁的新步行桥剪彩。

examples.en: Our mayor rides the same crowded bus to work daily.
examples.zh: 我们的「市长」每天和大家挤同一班公交车上班。

words.enDefinition: hanging cloth used as a blind (especially for a window)

examples.en: Grandma sewed blue gingham curtains for the kitchen window last week.
examples.zh: 上周，奶奶给厨房的窗户缝了蓝格「窗帘」。

examples.en: The velvet stage curtain opened on the twins' folk dance.
examples.zh: 丝绒「幕布」拉开，双胞胎的民族舞开演。

words.enDefinition: an enlarged and muscular saclike organ of the alimentary canal; the principal organ of digestion

examples.en: Grandpa's stomach growls very loudly right before Sunday lunch starts.
examples.zh: 周日午餐开始前，爷爷的「肚子」叫得特别响。

examples.en: Too many ripe plums gave the twins an upset stomach.
examples.zh: 熟李子吃多了，双胞胎「闹了肚子」。

words.enDefinition: have a certain weight

examples.en: The grocer weighs the rice on a small brass scale.
examples.zh: 杂货商在小黄铜秤上「称」大米的重量。

examples.en: Grandma weighed the recipe's total cost before buying the saffron.
examples.zh: 买藏红花之前，奶奶先「掂量」了一下这道菜的总成本。

words.enDefinition: set up for use

examples.en: The plumber will install the new sink on Thursday morning.
examples.zh: 水管工周四上午会来「安装」新水槽。

examples.en: Grandpa installed a small birdhouse beside the kitchen window himself.
examples.zh: 爷爷自己在厨房窗边「装」了个小鸟屋。

words.enDefinition: ready to attack or confront; energetic and determined

examples.en: The aggressive seagull steals fries right off the pier rail.
examples.zh: 那只「凶猛的」海鸥直接从码头栏杆上抢走薯条。

examples.en: Grandma's aggressive bargaining style wins the best prices at the market.
examples.zh: 奶奶「强势的」砍价风格总能在市场上买到最便宜的菜。

words.enDefinition: performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging

examples.en: The open-air harbor concert opens the summer festival every July.
examples.zh: 每年七月，露天海港「音乐会」拉开夏日节庆的序幕。

examples.en: Grandma saved two seats for the twins at the violin concert.
examples.zh: 奶奶在小提琴「演奏会」上给双胞胎留了两个座位。

words.enDefinition: the furthest or highest degree of something

examples.en: Heat and frost are the two extremes our orchard fears most.
examples.zh: 酷热和严霜是果园最怕的两种「极端」。

examples.en: Grandpa avoids both extremes and keeps the garden evenly watered.
examples.zh: 爷爷不走「极端」，把花园浇得恰到好处。

words.enDefinition: by reasonable assumption

examples.en: The bakery presumably moved because the rent doubled on Main Street.
examples.zh: 面包店搬家，「大概」是因为大街上的租金翻倍了。

examples.en: Judging by the cold tea, grandpa presumably napped through the storm.
examples.zh: 茶都凉透了，看来爷爷「多半」在风暴中睡着了。

words.enDefinition: not disposed to cheat or defraud; not deceptive or fraudulent

examples.en: The honest grocer rounds the price down when the scale tips high.
examples.zh: 秤若偏高，「诚实的」杂货商会主动少收钱。

examples.en: Grandma's honest answer saved us from buying the leaky boat.
examples.zh: 奶奶「坦诚的」回答让我们免于买下那条漏水的船。

words.enDefinition: become less tense, rest, or take one's ease

examples.en: Grandpa relaxes in the rocking chair after the evening news.
examples.zh: 看完晚间新闻，爷爷便在摇椅上「放松」。

examples.en: Mia relaxes her shoulders a little before every piano recital begins.
examples.zh: 钢琴演奏会开始前，米娅都会先「放松」肩膀。

words.enDefinition: any creature of exceptional size

examples.en: In the story, a friendly giant lends the children his umbrella.
examples.zh: 故事里，友善的「巨人」把雨伞借给了孩子们。

examples.en: Grandpa calls that oak tree the giant of our street.
examples.zh: 爷爷称那棵橡树为咱们这条街的「巨人」。

words.enDefinition: creating or arousing excitement

examples.en: The ferry ride at dawn was exciting for the whole family.
examples.zh: 黎明时分坐渡轮，全家人都觉得「兴奋」。

examples.en: Grandma finds the seed catalog more exciting than any novel.
examples.zh: 比起小说，奶奶觉得种子目录更让人「心动」。

words.enDefinition: timepiece that shows the time of day

examples.en: The station clock stopped exactly at noon, says the old caretaker.
examples.zh: 老管理员说，车站的「时钟」恰好停在了正午。

examples.en: Grandma winds the kitchen clock every Sunday after the cleaning.
examples.zh: 每周日打扫完，奶奶都给厨房的「时钟」上发条。

words.enDefinition: act as a critic

examples.en: Grandpa never criticizes our messy handwriting, only suggests slower strokes.
examples.zh: 爷爷从不「批评」我们字迹潦草，只建议把笔画放慢。

examples.en: The coach criticized the defense kindly after the friendly match.
examples.zh: 友谊赛之后，教练温和地「批评」了后防线。

words.enDefinition: person who is not very bright

examples.en: It was stupid of me to leave the tent unpegged before the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴来临前没把帐篷钉牢，我真「蠢」。

examples.en: Grandpa calls forgetting his reading glasses a stupid little habit.
examples.zh: 爷爷说忘带老花镜是个「愚蠢的」小习惯。

words.enDefinition: the hard outer covering of a sea creature or an egg

examples.en: The twins collected every spiral shell along the tide line.
examples.zh: 双胞胎把潮线上的每个螺旋「贝壳」都捡了回来。

examples.en: Grandma strings small white shells into a pretty window chime.
examples.zh: 奶奶把小白「贝壳」串成漂亮的窗边风铃。

words.enDefinition: time interval during which there is a temporary cessation of something

examples.en: The violinist took a long pause before the final movement.
examples.zh: 终乐章开始前，小提琴手做了长长的「停顿」。

examples.en: After a short pause, grandma continued her story about the lighthouse.
examples.zh: 稍作「停顿」之后，奶奶继续讲灯塔的故事。

words.enDefinition: recognizable kind

examples.en: Grandma swears by the flour brand she has used for decades.
examples.zh: 奶奶只认她用了几十年的那个面粉「品牌」。

examples.en: The farmer's jam jars carry a hand-drawn plum brand label.
examples.zh: 农场的果酱罐上贴着手绘的李子「商标」。

words.enDefinition: with everything included or counted

examples.en: Altogether, the family reunion filled six tables at the teahouse.
examples.zh: 这次家庭聚会「总共」坐满了茶馆的六张桌子。

examples.en: Grandpa stopped sailing altogether after the second big winter storm.
examples.zh: 第二场冬季大风暴之后，爷爷「彻底」不再出海了。

words.enDefinition: having or marked by confidence or assurance

examples.en: Mia feels confident about the piano exam after daily practice.
examples.zh: 每天练习之后，米娅对钢琴考试「很有信心」。

examples.en: Grandpa sounds confident when he predicts rain by the ants.
examples.zh: 看蚂蚁预测下雨时，爷爷的语气总是很「自信」。

words.enDefinition: statement that expresses a personal opinion or belief or adds information

examples.en: Grandma's kind remark about my dumplings made the whole table smile.
examples.zh: 奶奶对我饺子的一句善意「评价」让全桌人都笑了。

examples.en: The judge's opening remark surprised nobody in the quiet courtroom.
examples.zh: 法官的开场「评论」没有让安静的法庭里任何人意外。

words.enDefinition: mounting consisting of a piece of metal (as in a ring or other jewelry) that holds a gem in place

examples.en: The jeweler soldered a silver mount for the river pearl.
examples.zh: 珠宝匠为那颗河珠焊了一个「银托」。

examples.en: Grandma checked the brooch's mount before wearing it to the wedding.
examples.zh: 戴胸针去婚礼之前，奶奶检查了它的「底座」。

words.enDefinition: group of symbols that make a mathematical statement

examples.en: The chemistry formula for water is chalked on the classroom board.
examples.zh: 教室黑板上用粉笔写着水的化学「公式」。

examples.en: Grandma keeps her jam formula on a card inside the cupboard.
examples.zh: 奶奶把果酱「配方」的卡片收在橱柜里。

words.enDefinition: the finest or most superior quality of its kind

examples.en: Grandma's slow-roast lamb is the ultimate Sunday dish in this town.
examples.zh: 奶奶的慢烤羊肉是本镇周日菜肴的「极致」。

examples.en: For grandpa, winning the fishing derby is the ultimate reward.
examples.zh: 对爷爷来说，赢得钓鱼大赛是「终极」奖励。

words.enDefinition: brief description given for purposes of identification

examples.en: Read the warning label before mixing the paint with thinner.
examples.zh: 把油漆和稀释剂混合之前，先看警示「标签」。

examples.en: Grandma writes a date label on every jar of plum jam.
examples.zh: 奶奶在每罐李子酱上都贴上写有日期的「标签」。

words.enDefinition: document ordering the payment of money; drawn by one person or bank on another

examples.en: Close the window; the cold draft gives grandpa sore shoulders.
examples.zh: 关上窗，冷「风」吹得爷爷肩膀疼。

examples.en: The old barn door lets a draft through on windy nights.
examples.zh: 刮风的夜晚，谷仓的老门会漏进「穿堂风」。

words.enDefinition: the abode of God and the angels

examples.en: Grandma says the quiet mountain lake must be heaven on earth.
examples.zh: 奶奶说，宁静的高山湖泊一定是人间「天堂」。

examples.en: Grandpa jokes that a perfect dumpling is proof of heaven.
examples.zh: 爷爷打趣说，完美的饺子就是「天堂」存在的证据。

words.enDefinition: large amount of wealth or prosperity

examples.en: Grandpa spent a small fortune restoring the old ferry boat.
examples.zh: 爷爷花了「一大笔钱」修复那条旧渡船。

examples.en: The jeweler inherited a fortune of river pearls from his aunt.
examples.zh: 珠宝匠从姑妈那里继承了一笔珍珠「财富」。

words.enDefinition: eagerly desirous

examples.en: Grandma was anxious about the twins' first ferry trip alone.
examples.zh: 双胞胎第一次独自坐渡轮，奶奶很「担心」。

examples.en: The seedlings grow anxious for sunshine after a week of rain.
examples.zh: 连下一周雨之后，秧苗「渴」盼阳光。

words.enDefinition: the equipment used for a task or sport, such as fishing gear

examples.en: Grandpa rinses his fishing tackle in the stream after each trip.
examples.zh: 每次出钓归来，爷爷都在溪水里清洗他的钓鱼「用具」。

examples.en: Pack the camping tackle before the twins wake up tomorrow.
examples.zh: 趁双胞胎明天醒来之前，先把露营「装备」打包好。

words.enDefinition: food made from roasted ground cacao beans

examples.en: Grandma melts rich dark chocolate for the twins' birthday fondue.
examples.zh: 奶奶融化香浓的黑「巧克力」，给双胞胎做生日蘸酱火锅。

examples.en: The hot chocolate at the ski hut warms frozen fingers fast.
examples.zh: 滑雪小屋的热「巧克力」很快暖和了冻僵的手指。

words.enDefinition: round fastener sewn to shirts and coats etc to fit through buttonholes

examples.en: Grandma keeps a tin of spare buttons for every coat repair.
examples.zh: 奶奶存了一铁盒备用「纽扣」，随时用来补衣。

examples.en: The loose button on grandpa's old cardigan finally fell off.
examples.zh: 爷爷旧开衫上松动的「扣子」终于掉了。

words.enDefinition: covering designed to be worn on a person's body

examples.en: Warm clothing matters more than style on the winter ferry.
examples.zh: 冬季坐渡轮，保暖「衣物」比时髦更重要。

examples.en: Grandma donates gently used clothing to the village drive each spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，奶奶都把八成新的「衣物」捐给村里的募捐活动。

words.enDefinition: the property of sound that varies with variation in the frequency of vibration

examples.en: The referee's whistle reached a pitch that made everyone cover their ears.
examples.zh: 裁判的哨声「音高」尖得让所有人都捂住耳朵。

examples.en: Grandpa tunes the accordion until every single pitch sounds true.
examples.zh: 爷爷调手风琴，直到每一个「音」都准。

words.enDefinition: barrier that serves to enclose an area

examples.en: Grandpa mends the garden fence before the goats discover the tulips.
examples.zh: 赶在山羊发现郁金香之前，爷爷修好了花园「篱笆」。

examples.en: The white picket fence needs a fresh coat every spring.
examples.zh: 白色尖桩「栅栏」每年春天都要补一道新漆。

words.enDefinition: causing fear or dread or terror

examples.en: The traffic was awful after the bridge closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 大桥封路维修之后，交通「糟透了」。

examples.en: Grandma felt awful about forgetting the twins' small piano recital.
examples.zh: 忘了双胞胎的小型钢琴演奏会，奶奶心里「难受」极了。

words.enDefinition: formal event performed on a special occasion

examples.en: The bridge-opening ceremony drew half the town to the riverbank.
examples.zh: 通桥「典礼」把半个镇子的人都吸引到了河岸。

examples.en: Grandma's tea ceremony includes three bows and one quiet pour.
examples.zh: 奶奶的茶「仪式」包括三次鞠躬和一次安静的注水。

words.enDefinition: transmit information

examples.en: The twins communicate with hand signs across the noisy classroom.
examples.zh: 双胞胎在嘈杂的教室里用手势「交流」。

examples.en: Grandpa communicates his secret fishing spots only through sketched maps.
examples.zh: 爷爷只用手绘地图「传达」他的秘密钓鱼点。

words.enDefinition: feeling of excitement

examples.en: The twins showed great enthusiasm for grandma's dumpling masterclass today.
examples.zh: 今天，双胞胎对奶奶的饺子大师课表现出极大的「热情」。

examples.en: Grandpa's enthusiasm for beekeeping has spread through the whole village.
examples.zh: 爷爷对养蜂的「热情」已经感染了整个村庄。

words.enDefinition: (`cease' is a noun only in the phrase `without cease') end

examples.en: The rain fell without cease during the whole ferry crossing.
examples.zh: 整个渡轮航程中，雨「下个不停」。

examples.en: The tide worked without cease, moving our boat along the shore.
examples.zh: 潮水「不停地」涌动，推着我们的船沿岸前行。

words.enDefinition: making a strong or vivid impression

examples.en: Grandpa's hand-drawn harbor map is genuinely impressive for a fisherman.
examples.zh: 作为一个渔夫，爷爷手绘的海港地图「令人赞叹」。

examples.en: The twins' three-layer cake made an impressive birthday party centerpiece.
examples.zh: 双胞胎的三层蛋糕成了生日派对上「令人惊艳的」焦点。

words.enDefinition: hotel located in a resort area

examples.en: The quiet lakeside resort rents rowboats from April to October.
examples.zh: 安静的湖畔「度假村」四月至十月出租划艇。

examples.en: Grandma booked the mountain resort for the family's winter week.
examples.zh: 奶奶为全家冬季的那一周预订了山间「度假村」。

words.enDefinition: far away in distance or time; out of the way

examples.en: Grandpa's remote cabin sits three hours past the last bus stop.
examples.zh: 爷爷「偏远」的小屋在末班车之后还要走三个小时。

examples.en: The remote village school has exactly twelve pupils this year.
examples.zh: 今年，这所「偏远的」村小正好有十二名学生。

words.enDefinition: prove capable or fit; meet requirements

examples.en: The twins must qualify at the trials before the swimming final.
examples.zh: 游泳决赛之前，双胞胎必须先在选拔赛中「达标」。

examples.en: Grandma's dumplings easily qualify for the big county fair contest.
examples.zh: 奶奶的饺子「够格」参加大型县集市的比赛。

words.enDefinition: person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose

examples.en: The baker's assistant kneads the dough before sunrise each morning.
examples.zh: 每天日出之前，面包师的「助手」就开始揉面。

examples.en: Grandma still works as a library assistant every Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 每逢周二下午，奶奶仍在图书馆做「助理」。

words.enDefinition: casual meeting with a person or thing

examples.en: Our morning encounter with the heron became a family legend.
examples.zh: 清晨与苍鹭的「相遇」成了家里的传奇故事。

examples.en: The sailors spoke of a close encounter with a waterspout.
examples.zh: 水手们谈起与水龙卷的一次「险遇」。

words.enDefinition: the smallest possible quantity

examples.en: The ferry runs with a minimum of four passengers per trip.
examples.zh: 渡轮每趟至少要四名乘客，这是「最低」要求。

examples.en: Keep the heater at minimum power during the warm spring nights.
examples.zh: 春夜温暖，取暖器开「最小」档就够了。

words.enDefinition: people who have severe visual impairments, considered as a group

examples.en: The village library offers audiobooks for the blind free of charge.
examples.zh: 村图书馆为「盲人」免费提供有声读物。

examples.en: Grandpa volunteers to read news to the blind every Saturday.
examples.zh: 每逢周六，爷爷都志愿为「盲人」读新闻。

words.enDefinition: side by side

examples.en: The dolphin swam alongside our ferry for nearly ten minutes.
examples.zh: 海豚在我们渡轮「旁边」游了将近十分钟。

examples.en: Grandpa worked alongside the young carpenters all through the summer.
examples.zh: 整个夏天，爷爷都和年轻木匠们「并肩」干活。

words.enDefinition: closely constrained or constricted or constricting

examples.en: The jar lid is too tight for grandma's sore hands.
examples.zh: 罐盖太「紧」了，奶奶酸痛的手拧不开。

examples.en: Money is tight this month, so we skip the cinema.
examples.zh: 这个月手头「紧」，我们就不去电影院了。

words.enDefinition: any factual evidence that helps to establish the truth of something

examples.en: The bakery stamp on the bag is proof of purchase.
examples.zh: 袋子上的面包店印章就是购买「凭证」。

examples.en: Grandma wants photo proof before believing the giant cabbage story.
examples.zh: 没看到照片「证据」，奶奶才不信那个巨型卷心菜的故事。

words.enDefinition: visual display of information

examples.en: Grandma's growth chart on the door tracks the twins' heights.
examples.zh: 门上的成长「图表」记录着双胞胎的身高。

examples.en: The tide chart hangs right beside the fish market clock.
examples.zh: 「潮汐表」就挂在鱼市大钟旁边。

words.enDefinition: (physics) deformation of a physical body under the action of applied forces

examples.en: The rope showed signs of strain before the whole load shifted.
examples.zh: 整件货物滑动之前，绳子已经有了「绷紧」的迹象。

examples.en: Grandpa felt a muscle strain in his back after the harvest.
examples.zh: 秋收之后，爷爷背部肌肉「劳损」了。

words.enDefinition: relatively long narrow piece of something

examples.en: Grandma sews a bright strip of ribbon along the quilt edge.
examples.zh: 奶奶沿着被子边缘缝上一条亮色缎「带」。

examples.en: A narrow strip of sand separates the pond from the sea.
examples.zh: 一条窄窄的沙「带」把池塘与大海隔开。

words.enDefinition: water at boiling temperature diffused in the atmosphere

examples.en: Steam rose from the noodle bowls on the cold morning.
examples.zh: 寒冷的早晨，面条碗里冒着热「气」。

examples.en: The kettle's steam whistled while grandma warmed the heavy teapot.
examples.zh: 水壶的「蒸汽」呜呜作响，奶奶温着沉重的茶壶。

words.enDefinition: extensive tract of level open land

examples.en: Wheat fields cover the vast plain south of the river.
examples.zh: 河对岸南面的广阔「平原」上铺满麦田。

examples.en: The village sits exactly where the plain meets the foothills.
examples.zh: 村子正好坐落在「平原」与丘陵的交界处。

words.enDefinition: person who loves someone or is loved by someone

examples.en: Every animal lover in the village helped find the lost collie.
examples.zh: 村里每个动物「爱好者」都帮忙寻找那只走失的牧羊犬。

examples.en: The old letters revealed that grandpa was once her secret lover.
examples.zh: 旧信件透露，爷爷曾是她的秘密「恋人」。

words.enDefinition: member of a senate

examples.en: The senator visited our fishing harbor to discuss storm repairs.
examples.zh: 「参议员」来我们渔港商谈风暴后的修缮事宜。

examples.en: Grandma wrote to the senator about the village bus timetable.
examples.zh: 奶奶就村里的公交时刻表给「参议员」写了信。

words.enDefinition: passageway through or under something, usually underground (especially one for trains or cars)

examples.en: The train passes through a mountain tunnel right before our station.
examples.zh: 火车在到站之前穿过一条山「隧道」。

examples.en: Grandpa remembers digging a garden tunnel to the neighbor's yard as a boy.
examples.zh: 爷爷记得小时候挖过一条「地道」，直通邻居家院子。

words.enDefinition: literature in metrical form

examples.en: Grandma recites classical poetry while folding the family's spring laundry.
examples.zh: 叠家里春装的时候，奶奶都会吟诵古典「诗」。

examples.en: The harbor bookshop dedicates one whole shelf to sea poetry.
examples.zh: 海港书店专门留了整架书放海洋「诗歌」。

words.enDefinition: person who lacks knowledge of evil

examples.en: The court cleared the young fisherman, innocent of any charge.
examples.zh: 法庭证明那位年轻渔夫「无罪」，没有任何指控成立。

examples.en: The innocent twins blamed the cat for the broken vase.
examples.zh: 「天真的」双胞胎把打碎花瓶的事怪到了猫身上。

words.enDefinition: kind, mild, and careful; not rough or violent

examples.en: Grandma gave the frightened puppy a gentle pat on the head.
examples.zh: 奶奶「轻柔地」拍了拍受惊小狗的头。

examples.en: The gentle slope suits grandpa's short morning walks after surgery.
examples.zh: 手术之后，「平缓的」坡道适合爷爷清晨短途散步。

words.enDefinition: very recently

examples.en: The newly painted ferry deck gleamed in the morning light.
examples.zh: 「新刷的」渡轮甲板在晨光中闪闪发亮。

examples.en: Grandpa joined the village choir newly after his early retirement.
examples.zh: 爷爷提前退休后「新近」加入了村合唱团。

words.enDefinition: feeling of self-respect and personal worth

examples.en: Grandpa beams with pride when the town mentions his pier repairs.
examples.zh: 镇上提起他修的码头，爷爷满脸「自豪」。

examples.en: Grandma takes pride in folding every sheet into perfect corners.
examples.zh: 奶奶以把每张床单折出完美边角为「荣」。

words.enDefinition: to become ice or make something very cold; to stop money, assets, or activity from moving

examples.en: The pond will freeze by Friday if this cold keeps up.
examples.zh: 如果继续这么冷，池塘周五之前就会「结冰」。

examples.en: The bank froze the entire account until all the paperwork arrived.
examples.zh: 银行「冻结」了整个账户，直到所有材料寄到。

words.enDefinition: payment made in return for a service rendered

examples.en: Grandpa offers a small reward for the return of his compass.
examples.zh: 爷爷悬赏「酬谢」归还他指南针的人。

examples.en: Hot cocoa was the twins' reward for shoveling the walk.
examples.zh: 铲完步道，热可可就是双胞胎应得的「奖励」。

words.enDefinition: person who sings

examples.en: The harbor festival books a folk singer every single August.
examples.zh: 每年八月，海港节都会请一位民谣「歌手」。

examples.en: Grandma was the family singer until her voice cracked at sixty.
examples.zh: 六十岁嗓子沙哑之前，奶奶一直是家里的「歌手」。

words.enDefinition: get or ask advice from

examples.en: Please consult the tide table before booking the fishing charter.
examples.zh: 预订包船之前，请先「查阅」潮汐表。

examples.en: Grandma consults grandpa before every big purchase for the kitchen.
examples.zh: 每次大件厨房采购之前，奶奶都跟爷爷「商量」。

words.enDefinition: state of being relaxed and feeling no pain

examples.en: Grandma's knitted shawl brings comfort on every cold ferry ride.
examples.zh: 每次乘渡轮，奶奶的针织披肩都带来「温暖舒适」。

examples.en: The old rocking chair is grandpa's favorite comfort after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐之后，旧摇椅是爷爷最爱的「舒适角落」。

words.enDefinition: table consisting of a horizontal surface over which business is transacted

examples.en: The bakery counter displays the last two strawberry tarts today.
examples.zh: 今天，面包店的「柜台」上摆着最后两个草莓塔。

examples.en: Grandma leaned on the deli counter while waiting for the ham.
examples.zh: 等火腿的时候，奶奶靠在熟食店的「柜台」上。

words.enDefinition: certain to happen; unavoidable

examples.en: Rain at the picnic seemed inevitable, so we packed the tarp.
examples.zh: 野餐看来「免不了」下雨，所以我们带上了防水布。

examples.en: Grandpa says change is inevitable, even in the quiet harbor.
examples.zh: 爷爷说「改变」是「不可避免的」，连安静的海港也一样。

words.enDefinition: the line that appears to bound an object

examples.en: The harbor's dark outline glows against the sunset every evening.
examples.zh: 每天傍晚，海港暗色的「轮廓」在夕阳中发亮。

examples.en: Mia sketched the basic outline of the lighthouse before painting.
examples.zh: 上色之前，米娅先勾勒出了灯塔的基本「轮廓」。

words.enDefinition: skill in doing or making something by hand

examples.en: Grandma learned the craft of paper cutting from her grandmother.
examples.zh: 奶奶从她祖母那里学到了剪纸「手艺」。

examples.en: The craft of mending nets keeps the old fishermen busy.
examples.zh: 补网的「手艺」让老渔夫们一直忙碌。

words.enDefinition: not compact or dense in structure or arrangement

examples.en: One loose screw made the whole heavy garden gate rattle.
examples.zh: 一颗「松动」的螺丝让沉重的花园门整扇咔咔作响。

examples.en: Grandpa wears loose linen shirts during the humid summer weeks.
examples.zh: 潮湿的夏天，爷爷都穿「宽松的」亚麻衬衫。

words.enDefinition: the most interesting or memorable part

examples.en: The midnight fireworks were the highlight of the harbor festival.
examples.zh: 午夜的烟花是海港节的「最大亮点」。

examples.en: Grandma says the ferry ride is the highlight of every trip.
examples.zh: 奶奶说坐渡轮是每次旅行的「精华」。

words.enDefinition: the head of a religious order; in an abbey the prior is next below the abbot

examples.en: Grandpa had a prior appointment, so he skipped the ferry tour.
examples.zh: 爷爷有「事先」约好的事，就没参加渡轮游览。

examples.en: No prior experience is needed for the village pottery class.
examples.zh: 村里的陶艺课不需要「以往的」经验。

words.enDefinition: a mark, sign, or small amount showing that something existed or happened

examples.en: The tide erased every trace of footprints on the sand.
examples.zh: 潮水抹去了沙滩上脚印的所有「痕迹」。

examples.en: Grandma detected a trace of cinnamon in the secret dumpling sauce.
examples.zh: 奶奶从秘制饺子酱里尝出了一丝肉桂的「痕迹」。

words.enDefinition: not clean; covered or marked with dirt

examples.en: The twins' shoes were dirty after taking the muddy shortcut.
examples.zh: 走了泥泞的近路之后，双胞胎的鞋「脏」了。

examples.en: Grandpa wiped his dirty hands on the rag by the sink.
examples.zh: 爷爷在水槽边的抹布上擦净「脏」手。

words.enDefinition: structure that provides privacy and protection from danger

examples.en: The bus stop shelter kept us dry during the sudden shower.
examples.zh: 突降阵雨的时候，公交「遮雨棚」让我们保持干燥。

examples.en: The barn serves as shelter for stray cats every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，谷仓都是流浪猫的「避难所」。

words.enDefinition: affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings

examples.en: The cool harbor breeze made our evening walk quite pleasant.
examples.zh: 海港的凉风让我们傍晚的散步格外「惬意」。

examples.en: Grandma finds the quiet tea shop pleasant for long chats.
examples.zh: 奶奶觉得安静的茶馆很「宜人」，适合长聊。

words.enDefinition: to give someone a right to receive something or to do something

examples.en: Your new season pass entitles you to unlimited ferry crossings.
examples.zh: 你的新季票「让你有权」无限次乘坐渡轮。

examples.en: The coupon entitles each child to one free ice cream.
examples.zh: 这张券「让」每个孩子都「有权」领一份免费冰淇淋。

words.enDefinition: any venturesome undertaking especially one with an uncertain outcome

examples.en: Grandpa's small boat-sharing venture turned a profit within two summers.
examples.zh: 爷爷的小型合伙购船「生意」两个夏天就盈利了。

examples.en: Opening the second bakery was a risky venture for the family.
examples.zh: 开第二家面包店对全家来说是一次「冒险」。

words.enDefinition: the act of gripping and pressing firmly

examples.en: Grandma gave my hand a gentle squeeze before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试之前，奶奶轻轻「捏了捏」我的手。

examples.en: A firm squeeze of the sponge clears the extra water.
examples.zh: 用力「一挤」海绵，多余的水就没了。

words.enDefinition: an insignificant place

examples.en: The trail led nowhere, so we turned back before noon.
examples.zh: 小路「哪儿也」不通，我们中午前就折返了。

examples.en: The keys are nowhere in the kitchen, despite three searches.
examples.zh: 搜了三遍，钥匙在厨房里「哪儿都」找不到。

words.enDefinition: person who is frightened and in need of help

examples.en: The desperate farmers prayed for rain through the whole dry June.
examples.zh: 整个干旱的六月，「绝望的」农民一直在祈雨。

examples.en: Grandpa made a desperate last cast as the sun set.
examples.zh: 日落时分，爷爷「孤注一掷」地甩出了最后一竿。

words.enDefinition: someone who plays a musical instrument (as a profession)

examples.en: The street musician plays accordion beside the harbor every weekend.
examples.zh: 每逢周末，街头「音乐家」都在海港旁拉手风琴。

examples.en: Grandma's favorite musician plays guitar at the open-mic cafe downtown.
examples.zh: 奶奶最喜欢的「音乐人」在市中心的开放麦咖啡馆弹吉他。

words.enDefinition: the act of putting something in working order again

examples.en: The repair of the old pier took the whole autumn.
examples.zh: 旧码头的「修理」花了整个秋天。

examples.en: Grandpa's neat repair made the rocking chair look brand new.
examples.zh: 爷爷精巧的「修补」让旧摇椅焕然一新。

words.enDefinition: an animal skin made smooth and flexible by removing the hair and then tanning

examples.en: Grandpa keeps his tools in a worn leather belt pouch.
examples.zh: 爷爷把工具收在磨旧的「皮革」腰袋里。

examples.en: The saddler stitches thick leather by the harbor every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨，马具匠都在港口缝制厚厚的「皮革」。

words.enDefinition: the legal dissolution of a marriage

examples.en: After the divorce, Dad moved to the apartment above the bakery.
examples.zh: 「离婚」之后，爸爸搬到了面包店楼上的公寓。

examples.en: Grandma's cousin finalized her long divorce at the county courthouse.
examples.zh: 奶奶的表妹在县法院办完了拖了很久的「离婚」手续。

words.enDefinition: relative darkness caused by light rays being intercepted by an opaque body

examples.en: The old oak offers cool shade across the picnic tables by noon.
examples.zh: 正午时分，老橡树为野餐桌投下清凉的「树荫」。

examples.en: Grandpa rests in the shade of the harbor wall at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 午餐时间，爷爷在海堤的「荫凉处」休息。

words.enDefinition: joyful occasion for special festivities to mark some happy event

examples.en: The whole street joined the celebration after the bridge reopened.
examples.zh: 大桥重新通车后，整条街的人都加入了「庆祝」。

examples.en: Grandma's ninetieth birthday celebration filled the village hall with song.
examples.zh: 奶奶九十岁的「寿宴」让村礼堂充满歌声。

words.enDefinition: fear resulting from the awareness of danger

examples.en: Grandma felt sudden alarm when the smoke alarm beeped twice.
examples.zh: 烟雾报警器响了两声，奶奶心头一阵「惊慌」。

examples.en: The town watched with alarm as the river rose past the steps.
examples.zh: 河水漫过台阶，全镇人都「惊慌」地看着。

words.enDefinition: any bundle of nerve fibers running to various organs and tissues of the body

examples.en: The dentist says the nerve in that molar is still healthy.
examples.zh: 牙医说那颗磨牙的「牙神经」还很健康。

examples.en: Grandpa lost his nerve at the top of the high dive.
examples.zh: 跳台顶端，爷爷没了那份「胆量」。

words.enDefinition: sudden flurry of activity (often for no obvious reason)

examples.en: The twins' sudden burst of laughter woke the napping dog.
examples.zh: 双胞胎突然的一阵「大笑」吵醒了打盹的狗。

examples.en: A warm burst of applause followed the fisherman's tall tale.
examples.zh: 渔夫吹完牛，台下爆发出一阵热烈的「掌声」。

words.enDefinition: showing inventiveness and skill

examples.en: Grandpa's clever pulley lifts the feed sacks to the loft.
examples.zh: 爷爷「巧妙的」滑轮把饲料袋吊上了阁楼。

examples.en: The clever twins split the chores so both finish by noon.
examples.zh: 「机灵的」双胞胎分工干活，中午前两人都完成了。

words.enDefinition: the state of being friends (or friendly)

examples.en: The twins' friendship with the harbor cat began with sardines.
examples.zh: 双胞胎与港口猫的「友谊」从一条沙丁鱼开始。

examples.en: Grandpa and his rival have shared a quiet friendship for decades.
examples.zh: 爷爷和老对手保持着几十年的淡淡「友谊」。

words.enDefinition: clothing of distinctive design worn by members of a particular group as a means of identification

examples.en: The ferry crew's navy uniform matches the calm morning sea.
examples.zh: 渡轮船员的海军蓝「制服」与清晨平静的海一个颜色。

examples.en: Grandma sews name tags onto every school uniform before September.
examples.zh: 九月之前，奶奶给每套校「服」缝上名牌。

words.enDefinition: direct or strongly influence the behavior of

examples.en: The village council governs the use of the shared harbor shed.
examples.zh: 村委员会「管理」共用港棚的使用。

examples.en: Grandpa says old habits still govern his early morning walks.
examples.zh: 爷爷说，老习惯仍然「支配」着他清晨散步的路线。

words.enDefinition: person or thing equal to another in value or measure or force or effect or significance etc

examples.en: One ferry crossing is roughly the equivalent of two bus fares.
examples.zh: 坐一趟渡轮的钱大约「相当于」两趟公交。

examples.en: Grandpa says napping is the harbor fisherman's equivalent of meditation.
examples.zh: 爷爷说打盹「等同于」渔夫的冥想。

words.enDefinition: a lasting mark or influence left by someone or something

examples.en: The old mill still bears the impress of wartime repairs.
examples.zh: 老磨坊仍带着战时修葺的「印记」。

examples.en: Grandma's neat kitchen left a deep impress on every visitor.
examples.zh: 奶奶整洁的厨房给每位访客留下了深刻「印象」。

words.enDefinition: an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants

examples.en: The pumpkin contest judges weigh every entry at the fair.
examples.zh: 丰收集市的南瓜「比赛」上，评委给每个作品称重。

examples.en: Grandma entered her plum jam in the county contest again.
examples.zh: 奶奶又一次带着李子酱参加了县里的「比赛」。

words.enDefinition: cunning or deceitful action or device

examples.en: The fox played a trick on the gardener in the old tale.
examples.zh: 老故事里，狐狸用「诡计」捉弄了园丁。

examples.en: Grandpa taught me a card trick that fools every cousin.
examples.zh: 爷爷教了我一个能骗过所有表亲的纸牌「戏法」。

words.enDefinition: rigidly accurate; allowing no deviation from a standard

examples.en: Grandma is strict about washing hands before kneading the dough.
examples.zh: 揉面之前必须洗手，奶奶在这点上很「严格」。

examples.en: The ferry captain has strict rules about standing near the rail.
examples.zh: 渡轮「船长」对靠近栏杆立了很严的规定。

words.enDefinition: having a sharp, pungent taste; not sweet

examples.en: Grandma's herbal tea tastes bitter, but it cures the cough.
examples.zh: 奶奶的草药茶很「苦」，但能治咳嗽。

examples.en: The twins learned that unsweetened cocoa is bitter the hard way.
examples.zh: 双胞胎吃过亏才知道无糖可可有多「苦」。

words.enDefinition: cause to burst with a violent release of energy

examples.en: The old boiler might explode if the pressure valve sticks.
examples.zh: 如果安全阀卡住，旧锅炉可能会「爆炸」。

examples.en: The crowd exploded with cheers when the ferry docked early.
examples.zh: 渡轮提前靠岸时，人群「爆发出」欢呼声。

words.enDefinition: (sports) the act of swinging or striking at a ball with a club or racket or bat or cue or hand

examples.en: Grandpa's golf stroke sends the ball onto the green every time.
examples.zh: 爷爷每次「一击」都能把高尔夫球送上果岭。

examples.en: The swimmer's smooth stroke carried her across the harbor bay.
examples.zh: 游泳者「划水」顺畅，横渡了整个海湾。

words.enDefinition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected

examples.en: The curious twins peeked into every crate at the fish market.
examples.zh: 「好奇的」双胞胎在鱼市把每个货箱都翻看了一遍。

examples.en: Grandpa gave me a curious look when I mentioned the seagull.
examples.zh: 提起那只海鸥时，爷爷向我投来「奇怪的」眼神。

words.enDefinition: cue given to a performer (usually the beginning of the next line to be spoken)

examples.en: The teacher gave the shy young singer a gentle prompt.
examples.zh: 老师给害羞的年轻歌手轻轻「提词」。

examples.en: Grandpa needed a gentle prompt to remember the second verse.
examples.zh: 爷爷需要一点「提示」才记得起第二段歌词。

words.enDefinition: expressing love or a loving feeling; imaginative and idealistic

examples.en: Grandpa planned a romantic ferry ride for their fortieth anniversary.
examples.zh: 结婚四十周年纪念，爷爷安排了一次「浪漫的」渡轮之旅。

examples.en: The candlelit harbor bench felt romantic even in the drizzle.
examples.zh: 细雨之中，港湾烛光长椅也显得很「浪漫」。

words.enDefinition: soft silky fibers from cotton plants in their raw state

examples.en: Grandma buys soft cotton fabric for the twins' summer pajamas.
examples.zh: 奶奶买柔软的「棉布」给双胞胎做夏季睡衣。

examples.en: The port once shipped raw cotton north to the mills.
examples.zh: 这个港口曾经把原「棉」运往北方的工厂。

words.enDefinition: an object that floats on water; a decorated vehicle in a parade

examples.en: The fishing float bobbed twice before the whole rod bent.
examples.zh: 鱼「漂」点了两下头，整根鱼竿就弯了。

examples.en: The harbor parade built a giant crab float this year.
examples.zh: 今年的海港游行造了一只巨型螃蟹「花车」。

words.enDefinition: round yellow to orange fruit of any of several citrus trees

examples.en: Grandma squeezes fresh orange juice for the big Sunday table.
examples.zh: 奶奶为周日丰盛的餐桌现榨鲜「橙子」汁。

examples.en: The market stall glows with stacked oranges in deep December.
examples.zh: 深冬十二月，市集摊位上堆放的「柑橘」金光发亮。

words.enDefinition: violating or tending to violate or offend against

examples.en: His joke about the captain was offensive to the whole crew.
examples.zh: 他拿「船长」开的玩笑冒犯了全体船员，令人「不快」。

examples.en: Grandma found the loud motorbike offensive at seven in the morning.
examples.zh: 早上七点的摩托轰鸣让奶奶觉得「刺耳讨厌」。

words.enDefinition: relation of direct opposition

examples.en: The ferry's reverse gear rumbles when docking in strong wind.
examples.zh: 大风中靠岸时，渡轮的「倒挡」轰隆作响。

examples.en: Grandma's bread rose, quite the reverse of her last attempt.
examples.zh: 这次面包发起来了，与上一次「恰恰相反」。

words.enDefinition: willing to give and share unstintingly

examples.en: The generous baker adds an extra roll to every order.
examples.zh: 「大方的」面包师每单都多送一个面包。

examples.en: Grandma was generous with the jam on the twins' toast.
examples.zh: 奶奶给双胞胎的吐司抹果酱格外「慷慨」。

words.enDefinition: defense of some offensive behavior or some failure to keep a promise etc.

examples.en: Please excuse the mess; we are painting the hallway today.
examples.zh: 请「原谅」屋里乱，我们今天正在粉刷走廊。

examples.en: Grandma excused the twins' muddy shoes because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因为那场暴雨，奶奶「原谅」了双胞胎的泥鞋。

words.enDefinition: postpone indefinitely or annul something that was scheduled

examples.en: Fog forced the captain to cancel the first two crossings.
examples.zh: 大雾迫使船长「取消」了前两班航次。

examples.en: Please call the bakery to cancel the birthday cake order.
examples.zh: 请打电话给面包店「取消」生日蛋糕订单。

words.enDefinition: operating with minimal human intervention; independent of external control

examples.en: The bakery's new automatic door opens for grandpa's delivery trolley.
examples.zh: 面包店的新「自动门」会为爷爷的送货小车打开。

examples.en: Grandma set the heating on automatic before the winter trip.
examples.zh: 冬季出行之前，奶奶把暖气设成了「自动」。

words.enDefinition: cherished desire

examples.en: Mia's big ambition is to captain the school chess team.
examples.zh: 米娅的最大「抱负」是当上学校棋队的队长。

examples.en: Grandpa's only ambition left is to plant ten more peach trees.
examples.zh: 爷爷如今唯一的「心愿」就是再种十棵桃树。

words.enDefinition: periodical that is published every week (or 52 issues per year)

examples.en: The village weekly newspaper prints the ferry timetable every Friday.
examples.zh: 村的「周报」每周五刊登渡轮时刻表。

examples.en: Grandma reads the fishing weekly at the old harbor cafe.
examples.zh: 奶奶在海港的老咖啡馆读渔业「周刊」。

words.enDefinition: the state of being suspected

examples.en: The missing gnome raised suspicion between the two neighbor families.
examples.zh: 小矮人雕像失踪引起了两家邻居之间的「猜疑」。

examples.en: Grandpa's suspicion fell on the seagull rather than the raccoon.
examples.zh: 爷爷的「怀疑」对象是海鸥，而不是浣熊。

words.enDefinition: light and humorous drama with a happy ending

examples.en: The village hall comedy night sells out every single autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，村礼堂的「喜剧」之夜场场爆满。

examples.en: Grandma prefers gentle radio comedy to television dramas after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后，奶奶爱听温和的广播「喜剧」，不爱看电视剧。

words.enDefinition: characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling

examples.en: Grandpa's dry humour makes even the longest bus ride shorter.
examples.zh: 爷爷冷面「幽默」让最长的车程也变短了。

examples.en: Grandma's gentle humour turns every little mishap into a story.
examples.zh: 奶奶温和的「幽默」把每次小意外都变成故事。

words.enDefinition: relatively small granular particle of a substance

examples.en: A single grain of rice rolled under the hot stove.
examples.zh: 一「粒」米饭滚到了滚烫的炉子底下。

examples.en: Grandpa stores the wheat grain in the dry hay loft.
examples.zh: 爷爷把小麦「谷粒」储存在干燥的草料阁楼里。

words.enDefinition: a tool with bristles for cleaning, painting, or tidying hair

examples.en: Grandma's paint brush rests in turpentine between the fence coats.
examples.zh: 两遍漆之间，奶奶的漆「刷」泡在松节油里。

examples.en: The groom's brush shines the pony before the village fair.
examples.zh: 集市开始前，马夫用「刷子」把小马刷得油亮。

words.enDefinition: feel admiration for

examples.en: The twins admire grandpa's knot-tying skill more than any cartoon.
examples.zh: 比起动画片，双胞胎更「佩服」爷爷打绳结的本事。

examples.en: Visitors admire the harbor mural every first Friday of the month.
examples.zh: 每月第一个周五，游客们都来「欣赏」海港壁画。

words.enDefinition: situated within or suitable for inside a building

examples.en: The little cottage interior smells of pine and fresh paint.
examples.zh: 小屋「内部」满是松木和新漆的味道。

examples.en: The ship's interior was freshly painted before the long voyage.
examples.zh: 远航之前，船舱「内部」粉刷一新。

words.enDefinition: strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water

examples.en: Workers poured fresh wet concrete for the new harbor walkway.
examples.zh: 工人们为新海港步道浇筑了新鲜湿润的「混凝土」。

examples.en: Grandpa stamped his initials into the wet concrete porch steps.
examples.zh: 爷爷把姓名首字母按进未干的「混凝土」门廊台阶。

words.enDefinition: to pursue in order to catch or attain

examples.en: The retriever chased the frisbee across the whole muddy field.
examples.zh: 寻回犬「追着」飞盘跑过了整片泥地。

examples.en: The kids chased bubbles down the hill after the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐之后，孩子们「追逐」着泡泡跑下了山坡。

words.enDefinition: theater where films are shown

examples.en: The old harbor cinema shows film classics every Thursday night.
examples.zh: 老海港「电影院」每周四晚放映电影经典。

examples.en: We walked to the cinema because the last bus had gone.
examples.zh: 末班车开走了，我们步行去了「电影院」。

words.enDefinition: quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear

examples.en: Grandma showed quiet courage when the storm flooded the kitchen.
examples.zh: 风暴淹了厨房，奶奶表现出沉着的「勇气」。

examples.en: It took courage for Mia to sing her solo first.
examples.zh: 第一个上台独唱，米娅需要不少「勇气」。

words.enDefinition: share of something

examples.en: Grandma cut a thin slice of lemon for the tea.
examples.zh: 奶奶为茶切了一片薄薄的柠檬「薄片」。

examples.en: Each slice of the harvest cake weighs exactly the same.
examples.zh: 丰收蛋糕的每一「片」都一样重。

words.enDefinition: a place of burial for a dead person; a hole dug for a coffin

examples.en: Grandpa tends the family grave with fresh flowers every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，爷爷都用鲜花打理家族的「坟墓」。

examples.en: The old graveyard on the hill holds many sailors' graves.
examples.zh: 山上的老墓园里，长眠着许多水手的「坟」。

words.enDefinition: the date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)

examples.en: Grandma baked a big cake for the bakery's fiftieth anniversary.
examples.zh: 面包店五十「周年」庆，奶奶烤了一个大蛋糕。

examples.en: The town celebrates the ferry's first crossing anniversary every June.
examples.zh: 每年六月，小镇都会庆祝渡轮首航「纪念日」。

words.enDefinition: verbal formula believed to have magical force

examples.en: The wizard's magic spell turned the prince into a seagull.
examples.zh: 巫师的魔法「咒语」把王子变成了一只海鸥。

examples.en: Grandma jokes that her dumplings work like a spell on guests.
examples.zh: 奶奶打趣说，她的饺子对客人像施了「魔法」。

words.enDefinition: unhappy, worried, or emotionally disturbed

examples.en: The twins looked upset when the ferry left without them.
examples.zh: 渡轮没等他们就开走了，双胞胎看起来很「难过」。

examples.en: Grandpa got upset about the crooked fence row, but briefly.
examples.zh: 篱笆桩歪了，爷爷「心烦」了一小会儿。

words.enDefinition: feeling of extreme pleasure or satisfaction

examples.en: The twins squealed with pure delight when the dolphins appeared.
examples.zh: 海豚一出现，双胞胎就「欣喜」得尖叫起来。

examples.en: Grandpa takes great delight in teaching rope knots to visitors.
examples.zh: 爷爷非常「乐于」教游客打绳结。

words.enDefinition: one of greater rank or station or quality

examples.en: The young clerk asks her superior before changing any price.
examples.zh: 年轻职员改价之前，都会先请示「上司」。

examples.en: Grandpa served under a kind superior in the harbor office.
examples.zh: 爷爷在港务处工作时，有过一位和善的「上级」。

words.enDefinition: any art that invokes supernatural powers

examples.en: The street performer's magic trick fooled everyone at the market.
examples.zh: 街头艺人的「魔术」骗过了市场上的所有人。

examples.en: Grandma claims her dumplings carry a little bit of kitchen magic.
examples.zh: 奶奶说她的饺子带着一点厨房「魔法」。

words.enDefinition: 12 o'clock at night; the middle of the night

examples.en: The bakery starts the first bread batch shortly before midnight.
examples.zh: 面包店在「午夜」之前不久就开始烤第一批面包。

examples.en: Grandpa heard the harbor bells ring at exactly twelve midnight.
examples.zh: 「午夜」十二点整，爷爷听到港口钟声敲响。

words.enDefinition: gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth

examples.en: A rumour spread that the bakery would close in spring.
examples.zh: 有「传言」说面包店春天要关门。

examples.en: Grandma stopped the rumour by showing the landlord's new lease.
examples.zh: 奶奶亮出房东的新租约，止住了「谣言」。

words.enDefinition: sudden intense burst of radiant energy

examples.en: A bright flash of lightning lit the harbor clock tower.
examples.zh: 一道「闪电」照亮了港口的钟楼。

examples.en: The camera flash startled the twins during the ribbon cutting.
examples.zh: 剪彩时，相机「闪光灯」吓了双胞胎一跳。

words.enDefinition: person engaged in commercial or industrial business (especially an owner or executive)

examples.en: The retired businessman donates bread to the shelter every Friday.
examples.zh: 这位退休「商人」每周五给收容所送面包。

examples.en: Grandpa's old friend, a local businessman, saved the village pier.
examples.zh: 爷爷的老朋友，一位本地「生意人」，保住了村码头。

words.enDefinition: the rising of a body of water and its overflowing onto normally dry land

examples.en: The autumn flood reached the bottom step of the bakery.
examples.zh: 秋天的「洪水」漫到了面包店最下面一级台阶。

examples.en: After the flood, the whole village helped clean the harbor wall.
examples.zh: 「洪水」过后，全村人一起清理了海堤。

words.enDefinition: message that is transmitted by radio or television

examples.en: The radio broadcast about the storm reached every fishing boat.
examples.zh: 关于风暴的无线电「广播」传到了每一条渔船。

examples.en: Grandma's jam won a kind mention in the county broadcast.
examples.zh: 奶奶的果酱在县里的「广播节目」中被好意提到。

words.enDefinition: score in tenpins; knocking down all ten after rolling two balls

examples.en: The boat kit holds a spare propeller and two ropes.
examples.zh: 船上的工具箱里备着备用螺旋桨和两条绳子这样的「备件」。

examples.en: Keep a spare key under the flowerpot by the door.
examples.zh: 在门边的花盆底下留一把备用「钥匙」。

words.enDefinition: having the capacity for thought and reason especially to a high degree

examples.en: The intelligent shepherd dog opens the gate latch by himself.
examples.zh: 那只「聪明的」牧羊犬会自己打开门闩。

examples.en: Grandpa calls the octopus the most intelligent creature in the harbor.
examples.zh: 爷爷称章鱼是海港里最「有灵性」的生物。

words.enDefinition: experiencing or marked by or causing sadness or sorrow or discontent

examples.en: The intelligent shepherd dog opens the heavy gate latch by himself.
examples.zh: 那只「聪明的」牧羊犬会自己打开沉重的门闩。

examples.en: Grandpa calls the octopus the most intelligent creature in the harbor.
examples.zh: 爷爷称章鱼是海港里最「有灵性」的生物。

words.enDefinition: not fair; marked by injustice or partiality or deception

examples.en: Splitting one dumpling between three hungry cousins feels quite unfair.
examples.zh: 一个饺子分给三个饿肚子的表弟，实在太「不公平」了。

examples.en: Grandpa calls the new parking fee unfair to market vendors.
examples.zh: 爷爷说新的停车费对集市摊主「不公平」。

words.enDefinition: one of the large landmasses of the earth

examples.en: The ferry crosses to the continent every morning at seven.
examples.zh: 渡轮每天早上七点开往「大陆」。

examples.en: Grandpa sailed between the island and the continent for thirty years.
examples.zh: 爷爷在岛与「大陆」之间跑了三十年船。

words.enDefinition: not disturbed by strife or turmoil or war

examples.en: The lake looks peaceful before the motorboats arrive at noon.
examples.zh: 正午摩托艇到来之前，湖面显得很「平静」。

examples.en: Grandma enjoys the peaceful hour just after the market closes.
examples.zh: 奶奶享受集市刚收摊后那段「宁静」时光。

words.enDefinition: painful emotion resulting from an awareness of inadequacy or guilt

examples.en: Grandpa felt real shame after forgetting the twins' little recital.
examples.zh: 忘了双胞胎的小型演奏会，爷爷真觉得「羞愧」。

examples.en: What a shame the ferry left before the fireworks started.
examples.zh: 烟花还没开始渡轮就开走了，真是「可惜」。

words.enDefinition: jerky pulling movement

examples.en: Give the cap one more twist and the jar opens.
examples.zh: 再把盖子「拧」一下，罐子就开了。

examples.en: The gymnast finished with a graceful twist of the ribbon.
examples.zh: 体操选手以一个优美的丝带「扭转」动作收尾。

words.enDefinition: an expression of approval and commendation

examples.en: Grandma's praise for my dumpling folds meant the world to me.
examples.zh: 奶奶对我捏饺子手法的「夸奖」对我意义重大。

examples.en: The coach's quiet praise slowly built the young keeper's confidence.
examples.zh: 教练轻声的「称赞」慢慢建立起年轻门将的自信。

words.enDefinition: special variety of domesticated animals within a species

examples.en: The farm's new sheep breed handles the cold hills well.
examples.zh: 农场新的绵羊「品种」很耐寒，适合山地。

examples.en: That dog breed loves water more than any other breed.
examples.zh: 那个犬「品种」比其他品种都更爱水。

words.enDefinition: feel sad about the loss or absence of

examples.en: Grandpa voiced one sad regret: never sailing past the cape.
examples.zh: 爷爷说出了唯一的「遗憾」：从没绕过好望角。

examples.en: Grandma expressed real regret about selling the old blue rowboat.
examples.zh: 奶奶对卖掉旧蓝色划艇感到真心「惋惜」。

words.enDefinition: courageous; showing no fear in face of danger

examples.en: The brave ferryman rowed through the storm to reach the patients.
examples.zh: 「勇敢的」船夫顶着风暴划船去接病人。

examples.en: Be brave when the dentist checks the sore tooth, Mia.
examples.zh: 米娅，牙医检查痛牙的时候要「勇敢」。

words.enDefinition: recovery or preservation from loss or danger

examples.en: The coast guard's rescue of the kitten made the local news.
examples.zh: 海岸警卫队「营救」小猫的事上了本地新闻。

examples.en: Grandpa joined the night rescue after the fishing boat leaked.
examples.zh: 渔船漏水之后，爷爷参加了夜间的「救援」。

words.enDefinition: refined and tasteful in appearance or behavior or style

examples.en: Grandma's elegant grey shawl came from her old wedding trousseau.
examples.zh: 奶奶「优雅的」灰披肩是她旧日嫁妆里的物件。

examples.en: The swan's elegant glide across the pond calms the morning crowd.
examples.zh: 天鹅「优雅地」滑过池塘，让清晨的人群安静下来。

words.enDefinition: marked by dejection from being alone

examples.en: The lonely lighthouse keeper waves at every passing fishing ferry.
examples.zh: 「孤单的」灯塔看守员向每艘经过的渔渡轮挥手。

examples.en: Grandpa felt lonely the first winter after the shop closed.
examples.zh: 店关掉之后的第一个冬天，爷爷觉得格外「孤单」。

words.enDefinition: type or class

examples.en: Grandpa collects every commemorative stamp from the little harbor office.
examples.zh: 爷爷收集小港务所发行的每一枚纪念「邮票」。

examples.en: The red wax stamp seals the baker's special order forms.
examples.zh: 红色蜡「封章」盖在面包师的特殊订单上。

words.enDefinition: make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.

examples.en: The twins decorate the classroom with paper snowflakes in December.
examples.zh: 十二月，双胞胎用纸雪花「装饰」教室。

examples.en: Grandma decorates her jam jar lids with checkered cloth tops.
examples.zh: 奶奶用格子布「装点」她的果酱罐盖。

words.enDefinition: call attention to

examples.en: The new bakery will advertise its cinnamon rolls on local radio.
examples.zh: 新面包店将在本地电台为肉桂卷「做广告」。

examples.en: Grandpa advertised his boat repair service with a hand-painted sign.
examples.zh: 爷爷用手绘招牌为修船业务「打广告」。

words.enDefinition: feeling a need to see others suffer

examples.en: The neighbor broke the shared rake out of pure spite.
examples.zh: 邻居纯粹出于「恶意」弄坏了公用的耙子。

examples.en: Grandma hid the sweets not from spite but from care.
examples.zh: 奶奶藏起糖果不是「使坏」，而是出于关心。

words.enDefinition: (boxing) a blow with the fist

examples.en: The boxer's left punch ended the friendly boxing exhibition match.
examples.zh: 拳击手的左「拳」结束了这场友谊拳击表演赛。

examples.en: Grandpa shows a gentle punch combo from his navy boxing days.
examples.zh: 爷爷演示了一招当年海军拳击时代的轻「拳」组合。

words.enDefinition: serious collision (especially of motor vehicles)

examples.en: The car smash at the crossing snarled market traffic for hours.
examples.zh: 路口的「撞车事故」让集市交通堵了几个小时。

examples.en: Grandpa's smash at the festival badminton final won the point.
examples.zh: 节日羽毛球决赛上，爷爷一记「扣杀」拿下了关键分。

words.enDefinition: pesticide in suspension or solution; intended for spraying

examples.en: Grandpa mixes the rose spray in the old kitchen jug.
examples.zh: 爷爷在旧厨房壶里调配玫瑰「喷剂」。

examples.en: Sea spray misted our glasses on the front ferry bench.
examples.zh: 坐在渡轮前排，海「浪花」打湿了我们的眼镜。

words.enDefinition: as the agent of or on someone's part (usually expressed as "on behalf of" rather than "in behalf of");

examples.en: Grandpa accepted the medal on behalf of the whole harbor crew.
examples.zh: 爷爷「代表」全体港口船员领了奖章。

examples.en: Mia thanked the coach on behalf of the twins' team.
examples.zh: 米娅「代表」双胞胎的队伍向教练道谢。

words.enDefinition: able to move or be moved freely

examples.en: The mobile library van parks outside the market each Friday.
examples.zh: 「流动」图书馆车每周五停在市场外面。

examples.en: Grandpa stays mobile around the harbor with his new walking stick.
examples.zh: 有了新拐杖，爷爷在港口四处走动很「灵便」。

words.enDefinition: provide entertainment for

examples.en: Grandpa entertains the waiting room with stories of stormy crossings.
examples.zh: 爷爷用风浪夜渡的故事给候诊室的人们「解闷」。

examples.en: The twins entertain their cousins with shadow puppets at bedtime.
examples.zh: 睡前，双胞胎用手影戏「逗」表弟们开心。

words.enDefinition: the making of goods on a large scale using machinery; also, goods so made

examples.en: Local manufacture of jam jars keeps the harbor workshops busy.
examples.zh: 本地「制造」果酱罐让港口的工坊忙个不停。

examples.en: The mill's manufacture of wool blankets dates back to 1902.
examples.zh: 这家磨坊的羊毛毯「生产」可以追溯到 1902 年。

words.enDefinition: person or thing that takes or can take the place of another

examples.en: Vanilla works as a substitute for lemon in grandma's recipe.
examples.zh: 在奶奶的食谱里，香草可以「替代」柠檬。

examples.en: Mia played substitute keeper for the twins during the second half.
examples.zh: 下半场，米娅「替补」双胞胎当了门将。

words.enDefinition: metric unit of length equal to 1000 meters (or 0.621371 miles)

examples.en: The coastal trail runs exactly one kilometre past the lighthouse.
examples.zh: 海岸小径正好在灯塔前一「公里」处转弯。

examples.en: Grandpa walks two kilometres along the old seawall every morning.
examples.zh: 爷爷每天早晨沿着老海堤走两「公里」。

words.enDefinition: carefully thought out in advance

examples.en: The cracked vase was no accident but a deliberate act.
examples.zh: 花瓶碎裂不是意外，而是「故意的」行为。

examples.en: Grandpa's deliberate choice of the quiet harbor bench surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 爷爷「深思后」选了安静的港口长椅，让大家感到意外。

words.enDefinition: an agreement between parties (usually arrived at after discussion) fixing obligations of each

examples.en: The market bargain on vegetables feeds the orphanage for a week.
examples.zh: 市场上「划算」的蔬菜够孤儿院吃一个星期。

examples.en: Grandpa shook hands firmly to seal the little boat-share bargain.
examples.zh: 爷爷紧紧握手，敲定了小小的合伙用船「交易」。

words.enDefinition: painstakingly careful and accurate

examples.en: Grandpa gives the fishing boat a thorough scrub each Sunday.
examples.zh: 每周日，爷爷都把渔船「彻底」刷洗一遍。

examples.en: The vet ran a thorough check before clearing the pony.
examples.zh: 兽医做了「细致」检查之后才放行小马。

words.enDefinition: secret group organized to overthrow a government or occupation force

examples.en: During the war, the village underground hid sailors in the loft.
examples.zh: 战争期间，村里的「地下组织」把水手藏在阁楼里。

examples.en: The underground runs under the harbor to the stadium stop.
examples.zh: 「地铁」从港口下面一直通到体育场站。

words.enDefinition: happening slowly by small degrees; step by step

examples.en: The town made a gradual recovery after the winter storms.
examples.zh: 冬季风暴过后，小镇「逐渐」恢复起来。

examples.en: Grandma notes the gradual darkening of the plum jam each year.
examples.zh: 奶奶注意到李子酱的颜色一年年「渐渐」变深。

words.enDefinition: money that is risked for possible monetary gain

examples.en: Sailing without checking the tide chart was a costly gamble.
examples.zh: 不看潮汐表就出海，是一场代价高昂的「赌博」。

examples.en: Planting early tomatoes was a gamble that finally paid off.
examples.zh: 提早种番茄是一场「冒险」，但最终成功了。

words.enDefinition: to the greatest degree or extent; completely or entirely; (`full' in this sense is used as a combining form)

examples.en: The twins are now fully recovered from the winter flu.
examples.zh: 双胞胎的冬季流感现在已经「完全」好了。

examples.en: Grandpa explained the tide rules fully before our first charter.
examples.zh: 首次包船之前，爷爷把潮汐规则讲得「很透」。

words.enDefinition: from appearances alone

examples.en: Apparently, the harbor cats prefer the fish stall on rainy days.
examples.zh: 「据说」，下雨天港口的猫更爱去鱼摊。

examples.en: Grandpa apparently fixed the broken gate while everyone was asleep.
examples.zh: 爷爷「显然」是在大家睡觉时修好了坏掉的大门。

words.enDefinition: the process of giving careful thought to something

examples.en: The council gave careful consideration to the pier repair plan.
examples.zh: 委员会对码头修缮方案做了周密的「考虑」。

examples.en: Grandpa raised the ticket price without any consideration for students.
examples.zh: 爷爷上调票价时，根本没「考虑」学生。

words.enDefinition: everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something

examples.en: The label lists the content of every jam jar sold.
examples.zh: 标签上列出了每一罐出售果酱的「内容」成分。

examples.en: Grandpa read the letter's content aloud by the ferry rail.
examples.zh: 爷爷在渡轮栏杆边大声读出了信的「内容」。

words.enDefinition: wooden structure consisting of an upright post with a transverse piece

examples.en: The white cross on the hill marks the old chapel.
examples.zh: 山上的白色「十字架」标示着老教堂的位置。

examples.en: Grandma wears a small silver cross on a thin chain.
examples.zh: 奶奶戴着细链上的小银「十字架」。

words.enDefinition: the act of presenting a person to someone who has not met them before

examples.en: Mia's funny introduction of the new baker made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 米娅对新面包师的滑稽「介绍」把大家逗笑了。

examples.en: The harbor guide begins with a brief introduction to tides.
examples.zh: 港口指南以简短的潮汐「介绍」开篇。

words.enDefinition: room in a school where lessons take place

examples.en: The village classroom doubles as the chess club every Wednesday.
examples.zh: 村里的「教室」每逢周三还兼作棋社活动室。

examples.en: Grandpa's old classroom desk still shows his carefully carved initials.
examples.zh: 爷爷旧「课桌」上还留着他当年细心刻下的姓名首字母。

words.enDefinition: (computer science) a line of code written as part of a computer program

examples.en: The recipe's first instruction is to rest the dough twice.
examples.zh: 食谱的第一条「说明」就是把面团醒两次。

examples.en: A single wrong instruction and the whole recipe collapses completely.
examples.zh: 一条「说明」弄错，整个配方就全毁了。

words.enDefinition: connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces

examples.en: This bridge connects the fish market to the ferry pier.
examples.zh: 这座桥把鱼市和渡轮码头「连接」起来。

examples.en: Grandpa connected the long garden hose to the new tap.
examples.zh: 爷爷把长长的花园水管「接」到了新水龙头上。

words.enDefinition: discover the location of; determine the place of; find by searching or examining

examples.en: The coast guard located the drifting dinghy within an hour.
examples.zh: 海岸警卫队一小时内就「定位」了漂流的橡皮艇。

examples.en: Grandpa located the old stone well under the blackberry hedge.
examples.zh: 爷爷在黑莓篱下「找到了」旧石井的位置。

words.enDefinition: an explanation of meaning; oral translation

examples.en: Grandma's warm interpretation of the old recipe adds extra ginger.
examples.zh: 奶奶对老食谱的暖心「解读」是多加一点姜。

examples.en: The harbor guide offered an interpretation for the foreign tourists.
examples.zh: 港口导游为外国游客做了「口译」。

words.enDefinition: in actuality or reality or fact

examples.en: The new rota effectively halves our waiting time at the clinic.
examples.zh: 新的排班表「有效地」把诊所等候时间减半。

examples.en: The borrowed silver tape effectively stopped the old leaking bucket.
examples.zh: 借来的银色胶带「实际上」止住了旧水桶的渗漏。

words.enDefinition: some situation or event that is thought about

examples.en: The harvest was the main topic at the village meeting.
examples.zh: 收成是村会议上讨论的「话题」焦点。

examples.en: Grandma always avoids the topic of the old blue rowboat.
examples.zh: 奶奶总是绝口不提旧蓝划艇这个「话题」。

words.enDefinition: from this place

examples.en: The bridge was closed, hence the longer ferry queue today.
examples.zh: 桥封了，「因此」今天渡轮排起了长队。

examples.en: Grandpa recovered late, hence the much smaller harvest this autumn.
examples.zh: 爷爷病愈得晚，「所以」今年秋天收成少了很多。

words.enDefinition: something important that you succeed in doing by effort or skill

examples.en: Finishing the whole winter pier repair was grandpa's proudest achievement.
examples.zh: 完成整个冬季码头修缮是爷爷最自豪的「成就」。

examples.en: The twins' first solo crossing counted as a real achievement.
examples.zh: 双胞胎首次独自乘渡轮算得上真正的「成绩」。

words.enDefinition: in like or similar manner

examples.en: Grandma seasons the fish soup with dill; grandpa does similarly.
examples.zh: 奶奶用莳萝给鱼汤调味，爷爷「同样如此」。

examples.en: Similarly, the ferry crew checks the ropes twice each sailing.
examples.zh: 「同样地」，船员每次开航都把缆绳检查两遍。

words.enDefinition: for a very long or seemingly endless time

examples.en: Grandpa says he will fish these calm harbor waters forever.
examples.zh: 爷爷说他会「永远」在这片平静的海港水域钓鱼。

examples.en: The twins will remember this stormy crossing forever, they promise.
examples.zh: 双胞胎许诺会「永远」记住这次风浪中的渡轮之旅。

words.enDefinition: to interpret

examples.en: Grandpa interprets the cloud patterns better than the radio forecast.
