examples.zh: 爷爷「解读」云象比电台预报还准。

examples.en: The kind guide interpreted the captain's remarks for the tourists.
examples.zh: 好心的导游为游客「口译」了船长的讲话。

words.enDefinition: the act of communicating with a deity (especially as a petition or in adoration or contrition or thanksgiving)

examples.en: Grandma says a short quiet prayer before every ferry crossing.
examples.zh: 每次乘渡轮之前，奶奶都会做简短安静的「祷告」。

examples.en: The family joined hands for evening prayer after the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴过后，全家手牵手做了晚间「祈祷」。

words.enDefinition: have as an attribute, knowledge, or skill

examples.en: Grandpa possesses an uncanny memory for every tide table ever printed.
examples.zh: 爷爷「拥有」对每一张印过的潮汐表过目不忘的记忆。

examples.en: The rowing club possesses two rowboats and one leaky dinghy.
examples.zh: 划船俱乐部「拥有」两条划艇和一条漏水的橡皮艇。

words.enDefinition: of primary import

examples.en: The ferry route serves primarily the fishing families across the bay.
examples.zh: 这条渡轮航线「主要」服务于海湾对岸的渔民家庭。

examples.en: Grandma reads primarily old history books before going to bed.
examples.zh: 奶奶睡前「主要」读旧历史书。

words.enDefinition: make a mathematical calculation or computation

examples.en: Mia calculated the whole ferry fare for all nine cousins.
examples.zh: 米娅「算出了」九个表亲的全部渡轮票价。

examples.en: Grandpa calculates the tide times without ever opening the almanac.
examples.zh: 爷爷不用翻年历就能「计算」潮汐时间。

words.enDefinition: mark as different

examples.en: Grandma distinguishes her plum jam by the checkered cloth lids.
examples.zh: 奶奶的果酱靠格子布盖来「区分」。

examples.en: Only grandpa can reliably distinguish the twins' handwriting from each other.
examples.zh: 只有爷爷能可靠地「分辨」双胞胎各自的字迹。

words.enDefinition: human being; `wight' is an archaic term

examples.en: Every little sea creature hides when the big ferry approaches.
examples.zh: 大渡轮靠近时，每种小海「生物」都会躲起来。

examples.en: Grandpa respects every small creature that lives under the pier.
examples.zh: 爷爷尊重码头下栖居的每一个小「生灵」。

words.enDefinition: document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts

examples.en: Mia framed her new swimming certificate beside the ferry schedule.
examples.zh: 米娅把新的游泳「证书」裱起来，挂在渡轮时刻表旁。

examples.en: Grandpa's sailing certificate expired last spring, says the harbor office.
examples.zh: 港务处说，爷爷的航行「证书」去年春天就过期了。

words.enDefinition: accepted or habitual practice

examples.en: Grandma keeps the custom of baking fish-shaped bread in May.
examples.zh: 奶奶保持着五月烤鱼形面包的「习俗」。

examples.en: The local custom says never whistle on the ferry deck.
examples.zh: 当地「风俗」说，渡轮甲板上不许吹口哨。

words.enDefinition: an attribute that must be met or complied with and that fits a person for something

examples.en: A lifeguard qualification is required before the twins may compete.
examples.zh: 双胞胎参赛之前，必须先取得救生员「资格」。

examples.en: Grandpa's old pilot qualification earned him the harbor's ferry run.
examples.zh: 爷爷昔日的驾驶「资格」为他赢得了港口的渡轮航线。

words.enDefinition: mildly acid red or yellow pulpy fruit eaten as a vegetable

examples.en: Grandma's tomato sauce recipe needs six very ripe garden tomatoes.
examples.zh: 奶奶的番茄酱食谱需要六个熟透的园子「番茄」。

examples.en: The twins water the tomato bed before school each day.
examples.zh: 每天上学之前，双胞胎都给「番茄」床浇水。

words.enDefinition: a thick floor covering made of woven fabric or yarn

examples.en: Grandma beats the kitchen carpet outside on every first Monday.
examples.zh: 每月第一个周一，奶奶都把厨房「地毯」拿到外面拍打。

examples.en: The harbor cafe's dark green carpet shows every dropped crumb.
examples.zh: 海港咖啡馆的深绿「地毯」藏不住每一粒掉落的面包屑。

words.enDefinition: the mother of your father or mother

examples.en: Grandmother teaches the twins to fold dumplings every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 每逢农历新年，「祖母」都教双胞胎包饺子。

examples.en: My grandmother sailed this ferry route as a young woman.
examples.zh: 我「祖母」年轻时坐过这条渡轮航线。

words.enDefinition: the trace of a point whose direction of motion changes

examples.en: The coastal road follows a gentle curve around the bay.
examples.zh: 沿海公路绕着海湾划出一道平缓的「弯道」。

examples.en: Mia traced the curve of the harbor wall in charcoal.
examples.zh: 米娅用炭笔描出了港口堤岸的「弧线」。

words.enDefinition: an analytic or interpretive literary composition

examples.en: Mia rewrote her essay about the harbor after the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行归来之后，米娅重写了那篇关于海港的「作文」。

examples.en: Grandpa's old school essay about lighthouses still hangs framed proudly.
examples.zh: 爷爷学生时代写的灯塔「文章」还自豪地装裱挂在墙上。

words.enDefinition: the bulb of an onion plant

examples.en: Grandma chops one large onion before the soup starts simmering.
examples.zh: 汤开始炖之前，奶奶先切好一个大「洋葱」。

examples.en: The market's fresh spring onions made the whole family cry.
examples.zh: 市场上新鲜的「洋葱」把全家人都熏哭了。

words.enDefinition: inform positively and with certainty and confidence

examples.en: The captain assured us the ferry would wait five minutes.
examples.zh: 「船长」向我们保证渡轮会多等五分钟。

examples.en: Grandma assured the worried twins that the storm had passed.
examples.zh: 奶奶安慰焦急的双胞胎，「保证」风暴已经过去。

words.enDefinition: providing assistance or serving a useful function

examples.en: The librarian's helpful margin notes made grandma's research much quicker.
examples.zh: 图书管理员写在页边的「有帮助的」批注让奶奶查资料快多了。

examples.en: A helpful neighbor lent us his tide chart for the trip.
examples.zh: 一位「热心的」邻居把潮汐表借给我们这次旅行用。

words.enDefinition: major road for any form of motor transport

examples.en: The coastal highway closes completely whenever the autumn storms arrive.
examples.zh: 秋天的风暴一来，沿海「公路」就完全封闭。

examples.en: Grandpa drove the highway to the city twice last week.
examples.zh: 上周爷爷开车走了两趟进城的「公路」。

words.enDefinition: leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure

examples.en: The whole family takes its vacation in the fishing village.
examples.zh: 全家的「假期」都在那个渔村度过。

examples.en: Grandma saved her summer vacation days for the plum harvest.
examples.zh: 奶奶把暑期「假期」攒下来，留给李子收获季。

words.enDefinition: strong liking

examples.en: Grandpa has a strong preference for window seats on the ferry.
examples.zh: 坐渡轮的时候，爷爷「偏爱」靠窗的座位。

examples.en: Mia's preference in jam is strawberry flavor and never plum.
examples.zh: 果酱方面，米娅「偏爱」草莓味，从不选李子味。

words.enDefinition: having a physical or mental condition that limits movements, senses, or activities

examples.en: The ferry has a lift for disabled passengers with wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 渡轮为坐轮椅的「残障」乘客设有升降梯。

examples.en: Grandpa parks in the disabled space only with his permit.
examples.zh: 只有凭许可证，爷爷才停「残障」车位。

words.enDefinition: be of different opinions

examples.en: The twins disagree about who cooks the rice on Sundays.
examples.zh: 周日由谁来煮饭，双胞胎「意见不一」。

examples.en: Grandma and grandpa disagree about the best bait for bream.
examples.zh: 钓鲷鱼用什么饵最好，爷爷奶奶「看法不同」。

words.enDefinition: set containing all points (or all real numbers) between two given endpoints

examples.en: The ferry leaves at fifteen-minute intervals throughout the whole summer.
examples.zh: 整个夏天，渡轮都以十五分钟的「间隔」发船。

examples.en: Grandpa rests at short intervals while mending the long nets.
examples.zh: 补长网的时候，爷爷以短暂的「间隔」休息。

words.enDefinition: disorder resulting from a failure to behave predictably

examples.en: The train delay caused some confusion at the ferry ticket desk.
examples.zh: 火车晚点让渡轮售票处一阵「混乱」。

examples.en: There was confusion about which twin caught the bigger fish.
examples.zh: 谁钓到了更大的鱼，大家一时「分不清」。

words.enDefinition: woolly usually horned ruminant mammal related to the goat

examples.en: The shepherd counts his sheep twice before the hill fog rolls in.
examples.zh: 山雾涌来之前，牧羊人把「羊」数了两遍。

examples.en: Grandma's wool comes from the sheep on the eastern slope.
examples.zh: 奶奶的羊毛来自东坡上的「羊群」。

words.enDefinition: brief statement that presents the main points in a concise form

examples.en: Grandpa wrote a one-page summary of the whole harbor meeting.
examples.zh: 爷爷把整场港口会议写成了一页「摘要」。

examples.en: The recipe book ends with a summary of grandma's tips.
examples.zh: 这本食谱的结尾是奶奶窍门的「总结」。

words.enDefinition: restate (words) from one language into another language

examples.en: Mia helped translate the captain's safety instructions for the visitors.
examples.zh: 米娅帮忙为游客「翻译」船长的安全指示。

examples.en: Grandpa translates old sailor letters from Portuguese for the museum.
examples.zh: 爷爷为博物馆把葡萄牙语的旧水手信件「翻译」出来。

words.enDefinition: engage in a rehearsal (of)

examples.en: The twins practise their folk dance every evening this week.
examples.zh: 这一周的每个晚上，双胞胎都「练习」民族舞。

examples.en: Grandpa practises his rope knot-tying while waiting for the ferry.
examples.zh: 等渡轮的时候，爷爷「练」他的打绳结。

words.enDefinition: a written order to a bank to pay a stated sum from your account

examples.en: Grandpa still pays the yearly harbor fees by paper cheque.
examples.zh: 爷爷仍然用纸质「支票」支付每年的港口费用。

examples.en: The busy market stall finally accepts cheque payments on Fridays.
examples.zh: 繁忙的市场摊位终于在周五也接受「支票」付款。

words.enDefinition: food mixtures either arranged on a plate or tossed and served with a moist dressing; usually consisting of or including greens

examples.en: Grandma's garden salad uses only young leaves picked before breakfast.
examples.zh: 奶奶的花园「色拉」只用早餐前现摘的嫩叶。

examples.en: The little cafe serves a warm potato salad on Fridays.
examples.zh: 小咖啡馆每逢周五供应温热的土豆「色拉」。

words.enDefinition: meet the requirements or expectations of

examples.en: A single small dumpling hardly ever satisfies grandpa's enormous appetite.
examples.zh: 一个小小的饺子几乎从来「满足」不了爷爷的大胃口。

examples.en: The slow old ferry satisfies nobody during the summer rush.
examples.zh: 夏季高峰期，缓慢的旧渡轮让谁也「不满意」。

words.enDefinition: word used for misbehaving children

examples.en: It was silly of us to race the tide home.
examples.zh: 跟潮水赛跑回家，我们真是「傻」。

examples.en: The silly twins wore their swimsuits to the lighthouse tour.
examples.zh: 「傻乎乎的」双胞胎穿着泳衣去参观了灯塔。

words.enDefinition: rectangular block of clay baked by the sun or in a kiln; used as a building or paving material

examples.en: Grandpa salvaged old red bricks from the bakery's first oven.
examples.zh: 爷爷从面包店的第一座烤炉里拆下了旧红「砖」。

examples.en: The pier hut's brick chimney draws perfectly in all winds.
examples.zh: 码头小屋的「砖」烟囱在任何风向下都抽得很好。

words.enDefinition: make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose

examples.en: The twins adapted surprisingly quickly to the noisy harbor dormitory.
examples.zh: 双胞胎「适应」嘈杂海港宿舍的速度快得惊人。

examples.en: Grandpa adapted his old wooden rowboat for carrying fishing nets.
examples.zh: 爷爷把旧木划艇「改装」成能装载渔网的船。

words.enDefinition: mobile mass of muscular tissue covered with mucous membrane and located in the oral cavity

examples.en: The doctor asked grandpa to show his tongue very briefly.
examples.zh: 医生请爷爷伸出「舌头」很快地看了一眼。

examples.en: Grandma burns her tongue on the first dumpling every time.
examples.zh: 奶奶每次都在第一个饺子上「烫到舌头」。

words.enDefinition: any of numerous small rodents typically resembling diminutive rats having pointed snouts and small ears on elongated bodies with slender usually hairless tails

examples.en: A bold mouse stole the cheese rind in the pantry.
examples.zh: 一只大胆的「老鼠」偷走了食品室的奶酪皮。

examples.en: Grandma set two humane mouse traps behind the flour sacks.
examples.zh: 奶奶在面粉袋后面放了两只人道抓「老鼠」的夹子。

words.enDefinition: wild and exciting undertaking (not necessarily lawful)

examples.en: The twins call every single ferry crossing a small adventure.
examples.zh: 双胞胎把每一次乘渡轮都当作一场小小的「冒险」。

examples.en: Grandpa's wild youth was one long sea adventure, says grandma.
examples.zh: 奶奶说，爷爷狂野的青春就是一场长长的海上「冒险」。

words.enDefinition: support consisting of a place to rest the foot while ascending or descending a stairway

examples.en: Grandpa pauses on every third stair going up to the loft.
examples.zh: 上阁楼的时候，爷爷每三级「楼梯」就歇一歇。

examples.en: The narrow lighthouse stair spirals one hundred and eight steps.
examples.zh: 狭窄的灯塔「阶梯」盘旋着共一百零八级。

words.enDefinition: legal document giving official permission to do something

examples.en: Mia earned her junior sailing license at the little harbor club.
examples.zh: 米娅在小小的海港俱乐部考取了少年帆船「执照」。

examples.en: Check the taxi driver's license carefully before the long night ride.
examples.zh: 长途夜车出发前，先仔细查看出租车司机的「执照」。

words.enDefinition: ceremony at which a dead person is buried or cremated

examples.en: The whole harbor closed down for the old captain's funeral.
examples.zh: 老船长的「葬礼」那天，整个港口都歇业了。

examples.en: Grandma baked the family's blessing bread for the harbor funeral.
examples.zh: 奶奶为港口的这场「葬礼」烤了家传的祈福面包。

words.enDefinition: put forward a claim and assert right or possession of

examples.en: The twins both pretend to be asleep whenever bedtime approaches.
examples.zh: 一到睡觉时间，双胞胎俩都假装已经「睡着」。

examples.en: Grandpa pretends not to hear the twins' funny jelly-stealing confession.
examples.zh: 双胞胎「招供」偷果冻的趣事，爷爷假装没听见。

words.enDefinition: feeling or showing gratitude

examples.en: The grateful sailor thanked the whole crew with fresh fish.
examples.zh: 「感激的」水手用鲜鱼答谢了全体船员。

examples.en: Grandma is grateful for every neighbor who saved the harvest.
examples.zh: 奶奶对每位帮忙抢收的邻居都心怀「感激」。

words.enDefinition: prevent from leaving or from being removed

examples.en: Please confine all the paint mess to the garage corner.
examples.zh: 请把所有油漆的狼藉「限制」在车库角落里。

examples.en: Grandma confines grandpa's fishing tales to fifteen minutes at dinner.
examples.zh: 奶奶把爷爷的钓鱼故事「限制」在晚饭的十五分钟内。

words.enDefinition: restricted to something

examples.en: The little garden party is purely a neighborly tradition now.
examples.zh: 小小的花园聚会如今「纯粹」是邻里间的一项传统。

examples.en: Grandpa fishes purely for peace of mind, never for the market.
examples.zh: 爷爷钓鱼「纯粹」图个内心清静，从不是为了市场。

words.enDefinition: continuing in time or space without interruption

examples.en: The ferry service runs on a continuous loop till midnight.
examples.zh: 渡轮「连续」循环运营直到午夜。

examples.en: Three days of continuous heavy rain flooded the lower garden.
examples.zh: 「连续」三天的大雨淹没了下层花园。

words.enDefinition: the father of your father or mother

examples.en: Grandfather repairs the twins' paper kites better than any shop.
examples.zh: 「爷爷」修双胞胎的纸风筝比任何店铺都好。

examples.en: My grandfather still keeps his navy uniform pressed and folded.
examples.zh: 我「祖父」的海军制服至今熨得平平整整、叠得整整齐齐。

words.enDefinition: an employee who performs clerical work (e.g., keeps records or accounts)

examples.en: The sleepy harbor clerk stamps every landing ticket at dawn.
examples.zh: 清晨，睡眼惺忪的港口「办事员」给每一张卸货票盖章。

examples.en: Mia helped the clerk sort the market permits by hand.
examples.zh: 米娅帮「办事员」手工整理了市场许可证。

words.enDefinition: (usually in the plural) a garment extending from the waist to the knee or ankle, covering each leg separately

examples.en: Grandpa darns his old blue fishing trousers by dim lamplight.
examples.zh: 爷爷在昏暗的灯下补他那条旧蓝色捕鱼「裤子」。

examples.en: The twins rolled their trousers above the knee for the tide pools.
examples.zh: 看潮汐池的时候，双胞胎把「裤腿」卷到了膝盖上。

words.enDefinition: the branch of linguistics that deals with syntax and morphology (and sometimes also deals with semantics)

examples.en: Mia checks her grammar twice before mailing the harbor newsletter.
examples.zh: 寄出海港通讯之前，米娅把「语法」检查两遍。

examples.en: Grandpa learned his English grammar from an old sailor's phrasebook.
examples.zh: 爷爷从一本旧水手会话手册里学「语法」。

words.enDefinition: long narrow opening

examples.en: Grandpa sealed the crack in the harbor wall with cement.
examples.zh: 爷爷用水泥封住了海堤上的「裂缝」。

examples.en: A thin crack across the teacup made it grandma's favorite.
examples.zh: 一道细「裂纹」让这只茶杯成了奶奶的最爱。

words.enDefinition: go via an indirect route or at no set pace

examples.en: The twins wandered through the old bookshop for two hours.
examples.zh: 双胞胎在旧书店里「逛」了整整两个小时。

examples.en: Grandpa wanders the harbor every evening after the last ferry.
examples.zh: 末班渡轮之后，爷爷每晚都在港口「漫步」。

words.enDefinition: the act of punishing

examples.en: The punishment for skipping dinner duty is washing all the dishes.
examples.zh: 逃避晚餐值日的「处罚」是清洗全部的碗碟。

examples.en: Grandma believes kind words work far better than any punishment.
examples.zh: 奶奶相信温和的话语比任何「惩罚」都管用得多。

words.enDefinition: give an education to

examples.en: The coastguard program educates children about tide safety every summer.
examples.zh: 海岸警卫队的项目每年夏天「教育」孩子们潮汐安全。

examples.en: Grandma educates the whole family about plum pitting with patience.
examples.zh: 奶奶耐心地「教」全家怎么给李子去核。

words.enDefinition: the soft substance of an animal or human body

examples.en: The ripe peach's flesh turned golden by the kitchen window.
examples.zh: 熟透的桃子在厨房窗边，「果肉」变得金黄。

examples.en: Grandpa salted the fish and kept the flesh firm overnight.
examples.zh: 爷爷给鱼抹上盐过夜，让「鱼肉」保持紧实。

words.enDefinition: in a state of sleep

examples.en: Both twins fell asleep before the ferry left the harbor.
examples.zh: 渡轮还没驶出港口，双胞胎就都「睡着」了。

examples.en: Grandpa somehow stays asleep through even the loudest summer thunderstorms.
examples.zh: 再响的夏日雷雨，爷爷都能照样「熟睡」。

words.enDefinition: condition of urgency making it necessary to hurry

examples.en: There's no hurry at all; the bakery opens again at seven.
examples.zh: 完全不用「急」，面包店七点还会再开门。

examples.en: In her hurry, grandma forgot the tickets on the hall table.
examples.zh: 「匆忙」之中，奶奶把票忘在了门厅的桌子上。

words.enDefinition: someone whose occupation is printing

examples.en: The old printer still sets every village poster by hand.
examples.zh: 老「印刷工」仍然手工排版村里的每一张海报。

examples.en: Grandpa visited the printer to check the ferry timetable proofs.
examples.zh: 爷爷去「印刷工」那儿核对渡轮时刻表的清样。

words.enDefinition: the part of a building above the ground floor

examples.en: The upstairs bedroom catches the very first light every morning.
examples.zh: 「楼上」的卧室每天清晨迎来最早的一缕光。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps his maps in the upstairs study, not downstairs.
examples.zh: 爷爷的地图放在「楼上」书房，而不是楼下。

words.enDefinition: handwear: covers the hand and wrist

examples.en: Grandma knitted each glove a size bigger for winter growth.
examples.zh: 奶奶把每只「手套」都织大一码，好让冬天长个。

examples.en: Grandpa lost one sailing glove somewhere between the two piers.
examples.zh: 爷爷的一只航海「手套」丢在了两个码头之间的某处。

words.enDefinition: fully differentiated structural and functional unit in an animal that is specialized for some particular function

examples.en: The doctor listens to grandpa's heart, his busiest working organ.
examples.zh: 医生听诊爷爷的心脏，那是他最忙碌的「器官」。

examples.en: Grandma plays the little chapel organ every single Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 每周日早上，奶奶都弹小教堂的「风琴」。

words.enDefinition: an outbuilding (or part of a building) for housing automobiles

examples.en: Grandpa's cluttered garage smells of oil, rope, and sea salt.
examples.zh: 爷爷凌乱的「车库」里有机油、缆绳和海盐的味道。

examples.en: We parked the bicycles in the garage during the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴期间，我们把自行车停进了「车库」。

words.enDefinition: any female friend

examples.en: Uncle Ray proudly brought his girlfriend to the harvest dinner.
examples.zh: 雷「叔叔」自豪地带「女朋友」来参加丰收晚餐。

examples.en: Mia's shy cousin met his girlfriend at the harbor bookshop.
examples.zh: 米娅腼腆的表哥在海港书店认识了他的「女朋友」。

words.enDefinition: an elevated geological formation

examples.en: The gentle grassy slope behind the chapel suits morning walks.
examples.zh: 教堂后面长草的平缓「坡地」很适合晨间散步。

examples.en: Grandpa built steps down the steep slope to the beach.
examples.zh: 爷爷在陡「坡」上修了通往海滩的台阶。

words.enDefinition: capable of or reflecting the capability for correct and valid reasoning

examples.en: Grandpa's logical plan splits the heavy packing between two trips.
examples.zh: 爷爷「合乎逻辑的」方案把沉重的装载分成了两趟。

examples.en: It seems logical to book the ferry before the holidays.
examples.zh: 节前先订渡轮票，听起来很「合理」。

words.enDefinition: the branch of philosophy that analyzes inference

examples.en: The harbor queue follows a strange logic only grandpa understands.
examples.zh: 港口排队的「逻辑」很怪，只有爷爷看得懂。

examples.en: Mia used simple step-by-step logic to find the missing key.
examples.zh: 米娅用简单的循序渐进「推理」找到了丢失的钥匙。

words.enDefinition: the visible, glowing gaseous part of a fire

examples.en: A single small flame lit the old fisherman's storm lantern.
examples.zh: 一点小小的「火苗」照亮了老渔夫的防风灯。

examples.en: The campfire's dancing flames warmed the twins' wet woolen socks.
examples.zh: 篝火跳动的「火焰」烘干着双胞胎湿透的毛袜。

words.enDefinition: where in the world

examples.en: The twins bicker wherever they end up, even at the bakery.
examples.zh: 双胞胎「无论走到哪儿」都要斗嘴，连面包店也不例外。

examples.en: Grandpa hangs his old hat wherever the hook looks strongest.
examples.zh: 爷爷「随便」哪个钩子看着牢，就把旧帽子挂哪儿。

words.enDefinition: plumbing fixture that sprays water over you

examples.en: Grandpa fixed the dripping shower head before the twins' bath.
examples.zh: 双胞胎洗澡之前，爷爷修好了滴水的「淋浴喷头」。

examples.en: A quick warm shower cooled the tired players at halftime.
examples.zh: 中场休息时，快速的热水「冲淋」让疲惫的队员们凉快下来。

words.enDefinition: worthless material that is to be disposed of

examples.en: The village collects all the garden rubbish every Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 村里每周二上午收走全部的花园「垃圾」。

examples.en: Grandpa turned the old wooden crates from rubbish into planters.
examples.zh: 爷爷把旧木箱从「废物」改造成了花槽。

words.enDefinition: solid homogeneous inorganic substances occurring in nature having a definite chemical composition

examples.en: The high cliff wall glitters with a sparkling mineral seam.
examples.zh: 高高的崖壁上有一条闪亮的「矿物」矿脉。

examples.en: Grandma adds a pinch of mineral salts to the drinking jar.
examples.zh: 奶奶往饮水罐里加一小撮「矿物质」盐。

words.enDefinition: promise solemnly; take an oath

examples.en: Grandpa still swears the lighthouse blinked twice that foggy night.
examples.zh: 爷爷仍然「发誓」那个大雾之夜灯塔闪了两下。

examples.en: Mia swore to herself never to race the tide again.
examples.zh: 米娅对自己「发誓」再也不和潮水赛跑了。

words.enDefinition: set aside or apart for a specific purpose or use

examples.en: Grandma devotes her Saturday mornings entirely to the literacy class.
examples.zh: 奶奶把周六上午「全部投入」识字班。

examples.en: Grandpa devoted ten full years to repairing the old pier.
examples.zh: 爷爷把整整十年「心血」都投在了修旧码头上。

words.enDefinition: slender pointer for indicating the reading on the scale of a measuring instrument

examples.en: Grandma threaded the tiny sewing needle by the bright window.
examples.zh: 奶奶在明亮的窗边穿好了小小的「缝衣针」。

examples.en: The old tide gauge's needle stopped exactly at high water.
examples.zh: 老潮位计的「指针」正好停在高水位上。

words.enDefinition: relating to or characteristic of art or artists

examples.en: Mia's obvious artistic talent shows in her little harbor watercolors.
examples.zh: 米娅明显的「艺术」天赋显现在她的小幅海港水彩画里。

examples.en: Grandpa has an artistic way of stacking the fish crates.
examples.zh: 爷爷码放鱼箱有一种「艺术感」。

words.enDefinition: solid substance in the form of tiny loose particles; a solid that has been pulverized

examples.en: Grandma grinds cinnamon sticks into powder for the Sunday buns.
examples.zh: 奶奶把肉桂棒磨成「粉」，用来做周日的甜面包。

examples.en: Keep the box of washing powder dry under the sink.
examples.zh: 把那盒洗衣「粉」放在水槽下面，保持干燥。

words.enDefinition: public promotion of some product or service

examples.en: The harbor cafe's advertisement lured us in with pastry photos.
examples.zh: 海港咖啡馆的「广告」用糕点照片把我们吸引了进去。

examples.en: Grandpa pinned a handwritten advertisement about boat repairs on the board.
examples.zh: 爷爷在告示板上钉了一张手写的修船「广告」。

words.enDefinition: pause or hold back in uncertainty or unwillingness

examples.en: Grandma never hesitates to feed a hungry stranger at lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐时喂饱一个饥饿的陌生人，奶奶从不「犹豫」。

examples.en: Mia hesitated for a moment before stepping onto the plank bridge.
examples.zh: 踏上木板桥之前，米娅「犹豫」了片刻。

words.enDefinition: small amount of liquid food

examples.en: Grandpa took a slow careful swallow of the hot soup.
examples.zh: 爷爷慢慢小心地「咽」了一口热汤。

examples.en: The first swallow of cold juice after the race felt wonderful.
examples.zh: 比赛结束后来第一「口」冰果汁，感觉妙极了。

words.enDefinition: keyboard instrument that is played by depressing keys that cause hammers to strike tuned strings and produce sounds

examples.en: The harbor cafe's old upright piano needs tuning before Friday.
examples.zh: 周五演出之前，海港咖啡馆的旧立式「钢琴」需要调音。

examples.en: Grandma taught every little cousin one song on the piano.
examples.zh: 奶奶用「钢琴」教会了每个小表亲一首歌。

words.enDefinition: an object or statement produced before a court of law and referred to while giving evidence

examples.en: The harbor museum's newest exhibit is a salvaged drowned lantern.
examples.zh: 海港博物馆最新的「展品」是一盏打捞上来的落水灯笼。

examples.en: Each exhibit in the small lighthouse room has a story card.
examples.zh: 小小的灯塔展厅里，每件「展品」都配有故事卡片。

words.enDefinition: artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers

examples.en: Grandma cuts the checkered cloth squares for the jam lids.
examples.zh: 奶奶裁好一块块格子「布」，用来封果酱罐口。

examples.en: The young weaver's cloth sells out at the spring fair.
examples.zh: 年轻织工的「布料」在春季集市上卖光了。

words.enDefinition: a bright quality of light or polish on a surface

examples.en: Grandpa buffed the big brass bell until it took a warm shine.
examples.zh: 爷爷把大铜钟擦出了温润的「光泽」。

examples.en: The wet cobble street took on a silver shine after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后，湿漉漉的鹅卵石街道泛起了银色「光亮」。

words.enDefinition: reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them

examples.en: Grandma's kitchen dictionary has gravy stains on nearly every page.
examples.zh: 奶奶厨房的「字典」几乎每页都有肉汁渍。

examples.en: The twins share one little pocket dictionary between two desks.
examples.zh: 双胞胎两张课桌共用一本小小的袖珍「词典」。

words.enDefinition: change downward

examples.en: There was a steady decrease in the harbor's fish catch.
examples.zh: 港口的渔获量持续「减少」。

examples.en: A sharp decrease in ferry passengers followed the new bridge opening.
examples.zh: 新大桥通车之后，渡轮乘客「锐减」。

words.enDefinition: signal that temporarily stops the execution of a program so that another procedure can be carried out

examples.en: Please don't interrupt grandpa while he tells the storm story.
examples.zh: 爷爷讲风暴故事的时候，请不要「打断」。

examples.en: The loud greedy gull interrupted the twins' happy ice-cream moment.
examples.zh: 一只吵闹贪吃的海鸥「打断」了双胞胎开心的冰淇淋时光。

words.enDefinition: stop blaming or grant forgiveness

examples.en: Grandma forgave the greedy seagull for stealing the whole tart.
examples.zh: 贪吃的海鸥偷走整块果馅饼，奶奶还是「原谅」了它。

examples.en: Grandpa never forgives a badly tied fishing knot on deck.
examples.zh: 甲板上打得糟糕的渔线结，爷爷从不「原谅」。

words.enDefinition: (usually plural) close-fitting trousers of heavy denim for manual work or casual wear

examples.en: Grandpa wears his patched old jeans to fix the pier.
examples.zh: 爷爷穿着打补丁的旧「牛仔裤」去修码头。

examples.en: Mia rolled her jeans above the ankles for the stream.
examples.zh: 米娅把「牛仔裤」卷到脚踝上面，好去蹚溪。

words.enDefinition: limbless scaly elongate reptile; some are venomous

examples.en: A grass snake slipped across the garden path at noon.
examples.zh: 正午时分，一条草「蛇」溜过了花园小径。

examples.en: Grandpa taught us to leave any wild snake completely alone.
examples.zh: 爷爷教我们，碰到任何野「蛇」都别去碰。

words.enDefinition: hinge joint between the forearm and upper arm and the corresponding joint in the forelimb of a quadruped

examples.en: Grandpa leaned his elbow on the pier rail, watching gulls.
examples.zh: 爷爷「手肘」撑在码头栏杆上，望着海鸥。

examples.en: Mia scraped her elbow sliding into the rocky tide pool.
examples.zh: 米娅滑进多石的潮汐池时擦伤了「手肘」。

words.enDefinition: restricted to something

examples.en: The bakery closes strictly at six, never a minute later.
examples.zh: 面包店「严格」六点打烊，一分钟也不多留。

examples.en: Grandpa strictly follows the printed tide chart before every trip.
examples.zh: 每次出海之前，爷爷都「严格」按照印好的潮汐表来。

words.enDefinition: the quality of having an inferior or less favorable position

examples.en: The ferry's main disadvantage is the very long summer queue.
examples.zh: 渡轮的主要「缺点」是夏天排队时间很长。

examples.en: Being the youngest cousin has one disadvantage: last pick of dumplings.
examples.zh: 当最小的表弟有个「坏处」：饺子总是最后挑。

words.enDefinition: mistake one thing for another

examples.en: The identical twins confuse every single substitute teacher at school.
examples.zh: 长得一模一样的双胞胎把学校每个代课老师都「搞混」。

examples.en: Don't confuse grandma's homemade plum jam with the cherry jars.
examples.zh: 别把奶奶自制的李子酱和樱桃罐「弄混」了。

words.enDefinition: the quality of having a moderate degree of heat

examples.en: The warmth of grandma's little kitchen hugs every winter guest.
examples.zh: 奶奶小厨房的「温暖」拥抱每一位冬日来客。

examples.en: Grandpa felt the warmth of the whole harbor crew's welcome.
examples.zh: 爷爷感受到了全体港口船员「热情」的欢迎。

words.enDefinition: lacking or indicating lack of confidence or assurance

examples.en: The twins are uncertain whether the last ferry has left.
examples.zh: 双胞胎「不确定」末班渡轮是否已经开走。

examples.en: Grandpa sounded uncertain about the exact tide time for once.
examples.zh: 难得有一次，爷爷对确切的潮时听起来「拿不准」。

words.enDefinition: room or building equipped with one or more toilets

examples.en: The harbor station toilet has a funny hand-painted door sign.
examples.zh: 港口车站的「厕所」门上挂着一块有趣的手绘标牌。

examples.en: Grandpa fixed the wobbly toilet seat before the twins visited.
examples.zh: 双胞胎来访之前，爷爷修好了晃动的「马桶」座圈。

words.enDefinition: the act of refusing

examples.en: Grandpa's firm refusal to sell the boat surprised the dealer.
examples.zh: 爷爷「拒绝」卖船的坚决态度让经销商很意外。

examples.en: After one polite refusal, the vendor added several extra plums.
examples.zh: 礼貌「回绝」了一次之后，摊贩又多添了几个李子。

words.enDefinition: at a previous time;

examples.en: This little bakery was formerly a lighthouse keeper's stone cottage.
examples.zh: 这家小面包店「从前」是灯塔看守人的石头小屋。

examples.en: Grandma, formerly a night nurse, still keeps every ward habit.
examples.zh: 奶奶「从前」当过夜班护士，至今保留着病房里的习惯。

words.enDefinition: cloth covering that forms the part of a garment below the waist

examples.en: Grandma's long pleated skirt spins perfectly during her folk dance.
examples.zh: 奶奶跳民族舞时，长长的百褶「裙」转得恰到好处。

examples.en: Mia pinned her skirt before riding the harbor ferris wheel.
examples.zh: 坐港口摩天轮之前，米娅用别针别好了「裙摆」。

words.enDefinition: located, suited for, or taking place in the open air

examples.en: The outdoor chess tables fill up by ten every morning.
examples.zh: 「户外」棋桌每天上午十点前就坐满了。

examples.en: Grandpa prefers simple outdoor breakfasts on the sunny sea wall.
examples.zh: 爷爷「偏爱」在向阳的海堤上简单吃顿「户外」早餐。

words.enDefinition: aware or expressing awareness of things as they really are

examples.en: Grandpa set a realistic budget for the whole pier repairs.
examples.zh: 爷爷为整个码头修缮定了一个「切合实际的」预算。

examples.en: Mia keeps a realistic weekly study plan for the exam.
examples.zh: 米娅为考试制定了「现实的」每周学习计划。

words.enDefinition: act in concert or unite in a common purpose or belief

examples.en: The two fishing villages united to rebuild the storm-damaged pier.
examples.zh: 两个渔村「联合」起来重建被风暴损坏的码头。

examples.en: The neighbors united against the plan to close the bakery.
examples.zh: 邻居们「联合」反对关闭面包店的计划。

words.enDefinition: inspiring scornful pity

examples.en: Charging visitors for sea air sounds completely ridiculous, says grandma.
examples.zh: 奶奶说，向游客收「海风费」实在「荒谬」。

examples.en: The ridiculous rumor about the mermaid spread through the school.
examples.zh: 关于美人鱼的「荒唐」谣言传遍了整个学校。

words.enDefinition: not necessary

examples.en: Warming the oven twice is unnecessary for this small bake.
examples.zh: 烤这么少的东西，把烤箱预热两次「没必要」。

examples.en: Grandpa cut the unnecessary extra rope from the boat's mooring.
examples.zh: 爷爷剪掉了船只系缆上「多余」的绳子。

words.enDefinition: conducive to or feeling mental discomfort

examples.en: The hard wooden bench feels uncomfortable after ten whole minutes.
examples.zh: 硬木凳坐满十分钟之后就觉得「不舒服」了。

examples.en: Grandpa felt quite uncomfortable in his stiff new harbor uniform.
examples.zh: 穿上硬挺的新港口制服，爷爷觉得浑身「不自在」。

words.enDefinition: performer who dances professionally

examples.en: The folk dancer teaches the twins the harbor reel dance.
examples.zh: 民族「舞者」教双胞胎跳港口里尔舞。

examples.en: Every young dancer warmed up on deck before the festival.
examples.zh: 节日开始前，每位年轻「舞者」都在甲板上热身。

words.enDefinition: rectangular piece of absorbent cloth (or paper) for drying or wiping

examples.en: Grandma folds one fresh clean towel over every bathroom rail.
examples.zh: 奶奶在浴室的每根杆子上都搭一条干净的新「毛巾」。

examples.en: Grandpa dried the muddy dog with the old beach towel.
examples.zh: 爷爷用旧海滩「毛巾」把满身泥的狗擦干了。

words.enDefinition: the action of fetching

examples.en: One fetch of water saves three trips to the well.
examples.zh: 一趟「取水」能省去三趟井边的往返。

examples.en: The dog's fetch of the stick entertained the whole pier.
examples.zh: 狗一趟「衔回」木棍，逗乐了整个码头。

words.enDefinition: small room (or recess) or cabinet used for storage space

examples.en: Grandma's little spice cupboard holds forty small neatly labeled jars.
examples.zh: 奶奶的小小香料「橱柜」里放着四十个贴好标签的小玻璃罐。

examples.en: Grandpa found the old ferry map behind the cupboard door.
examples.zh: 爷爷在「橱柜」门后找到了旧渡轮地图。

words.enDefinition: spontaneous loss of consciousness caused by insufficient blood to the brain

examples.en: Grandma nearly had a faint when the old boiler hissed.
examples.zh: 旧锅炉嘶嘶作响的时候，奶奶差点「晕」过去。

examples.en: A brief faint at the award ceremony scared the twins.
examples.zh: 颁奖礼上短暂的「昏厥」吓坏了双胞胎。
